entries.meaningZh: 红桃A；扑克牌中的一张
entries.en: The ace of hearts was the last card left on the table.
entries.zh: 红桃A是桌上剩下的最后一张牌。

entries.meaningZh: 无细胞型黏菌；营养阶段可形成多核原质团的黏菌
entries.en: The acellular slime mold spread across the damp log as it fed.
entries.zh: 那团无细胞型黏菌在取食时沿着潮湿的原木表面扩展。

entries.meaningZh: 无彩色；黑、白或灰等没有色相的颜色
entries.en: Grey is an achromatic color; the sample has lightness but no hue.
entries.zh: 灰色属于无彩色；这个色样有明度，但没有色相。

entries.meaningZh: 杂技技巧；杂技演员完成的高难度动作（非飞行特技）
entries.en: Balancing on the moving ladder was an acrobatic feat that drew gasps from the audience.
entries.zh: 在移动的梯子上保持平衡是一项高难度杂技动作，引得观众惊叹。

entries.meaningZh: 以行为发泄或表达难以处理的情绪（心理学用语）
entries.en: The chapter discusses acting out as a way of expressing feelings that are hard to put into words.
entries.zh: 这一章讨论了用行为发泄或表达难以用语言说明的情绪的现象。

entries.meaningZh: 实际损害赔偿；对已证实损失作出的补偿性赔偿
entries.en: The judgment listed actual damages separately from the punitive award.
entries.zh: 判决把实际损害赔偿与惩罚性赔偿分开列出。

entries.meaningZh: 倡议团体；为特定议题或群体争取支持的组织
entries.en: The advocacy group collected residents' views before speaking at the council meeting.
entries.zh: 那个倡议团体在议会会议上发言前，先收集了居民的意见。

entries.meaningZh: 气雾喷罐（旧称；本例指杀虫剂喷罐，不是烟幕弹）
entries.en: The old manual illustrates an aerosol bomb used to dispense insecticide.
entries.zh: 那本旧手册画出了一种用于喷出杀虫剂的气雾喷罐。

entries.meaningZh: 严重袭击；情节加重的袭击罪（法律术语）
entries.en: The indictment included a charge of aggravated assault.
entries.zh: 起诉书包括一项严重袭击罪指控。

entries.meaningZh: Aletris farinosa 的通称；一种北美多年生草本植物（不泛指治疟草药）
entries.en: The botanist photographed the ague grass before recording its scientific name.
entries.zh: 植物学家先拍摄了那株 Aletris farinosa，再记下它的学名。

entries.meaningZh: anophorite；日内瓦大学矿物数据库列为 ferrinyboite 同义名的旧矿物名称
entries.en: The catalogue retained anophorite as a cross-reference to ferrinyboite.
entries.zh: 目录保留 anophorite 作为转引 ferrinyboite 的旧矿物名称。

entries.meaningZh: anou；柏柏尔语中表示井的普通名词（本例为地方地理词，不指某个特定地名）
entries.en: The guide pointed to an anou, explaining that the Berber word meant a well.
entries.zh: 向导指着一口井，解释说柏柏尔语中称井为 anou。

entries.meaningZh: 豆状核袢切断术；针对 ansa lenticularis 的历史神经外科破坏术
entries.en: The old surgical diagram marked where ansotomy interrupted the ansa lenticularis.
entries.zh: 那张旧手术图标出了袢切断术中断豆状核袢的位置。

entries.meaningZh: 前壁；纺锤虫随新增房室而向前扩展的生长面（本例为纺锤虫化石）
entries.en: A clear line on the fossil helped the student locate the antetheca.
entries.zh: 化石上一条清晰的线，帮助学生辨认出了原来作为生长面的前壁。

entries.meaningZh: 煤岩相学；对煤进行岩石学研究和描述的学科
entries.en: In anthracography, she compared the visible constituents of the two coal samples.
entries.zh: 在煤岩相学研究中，她比较了两个煤样中可辨认的组成部分。

entries.meaningZh: 煤化作用；植物物质逐渐转变为煤的过程（旧矿业词典所录形式）
entries.en: The geologist studied anthracolitization to understand how the buried plant material had become coal.
entries.zh: 地质学家研究煤化作用，以了解埋藏的植物物质如何变成煤。

entries.meaningZh: 棕黑色天然矿物树脂；旧矿物学所称 anthracoxene（不当作单一纯化合物）
entries.en: She mistook the brown-black anthracoxene for coal until she read that it was a mineral resin.
entries.zh: 她起初把那块棕黑色的 anthracoxene 误认作煤，读了说明才知道它是一种矿物树脂。

entries.meaningZh: 人类活动生态学；研究人类活动影响下的生态关系（本例为河流水体生态）
entries.en: Her study of anthropecology examined how the factory's wastewater changed the river habitat.
entries.zh: 她的人类活动生态学研究考察了工厂废水如何改变河流生境。

entries.meaningZh: 人体运动学；研究人体活动与运动的学科（本例取大学相关系所的运动科学义）
entries.en: Her interest in anthropokinetics began with a project on how older adults adapt their walking pace.
entries.zh: 她对人体运动学的兴趣始于一个研究老年人如何调整步行速度的项目。

entries.meaningZh: 抗衰老剂（复数；本例为化妆品或皮肤科制剂中以抗衰老为目的的成分，不声称疗效）
entries.en: The dermatologist asked which anti-agers were in the cream before discussing its claims.
entries.zh: 讨论那款面霜的功效宣称前，皮肤科医生先询问其中含有哪些抗衰老成分。

entries.meaningZh: 抗砷中毒的；拮抗砷化合物毒性作用的
entries.en: The study assessed the antiarsenical activity of the compounds alongside their toxicity.
entries.zh: 研究在评估这些化合物抗砷中毒作用的同时，也评估了它们的毒性。

entries.meaningZh: 拮抗生物；参与抗生作用的生物（本例为产生抑菌物质的一方）
entries.en: The fungus acted as an antibiont by releasing a substance that inhibited nearby bacteria.
entries.zh: 那种真菌通过释放能抑制邻近细菌的物质，发挥了拮抗生物的作用。

entries.meaningZh: 强迫方；反造者—反破坏者位置博弈中迫使对手凑齐致败集合的一方（本例选博弈论义）
entries.en: The antibreaker won when her opponent was forced to complete a losing set.
entries.zh: 强迫方在对手被迫凑齐一个致败集合时获胜。

entries.meaningZh: 抗抑素；旧细胞生成研究中与抑素相对、促进细胞生成的调节因子
entries.en: The model predicted faster cell production when the balance shifted toward antichalone.
entries.zh: 模型预测，当平衡偏向抗抑素一方时，细胞生成会加快。

entries.meaningZh: 反社群；内部连接很少、主要与组外节点相连的一组节点（本例选网络科学义）
entries.en: The network map highlighted an anti-community whose members had far more links outside the group than within it.
entries.zh: 网络图突出显示了一个反社群，其中成员与组外节点的连接远多于组内连接。

entries.meaningZh: 宝光（佛光）；出现在背日方向、观察者影子周围的彩色光环，即 glory
entries.en: The hiker saw an anticorona encircling the shadow of her head on the mist below.
entries.zh: 徒步者看到下方雾中自己头部的影子周围环绕着宝光。

entries.meaningZh: 防爬的；防止钢轨沿纵向窜动的（铁路工程义）
entries.en: The anticreep anchors held the rails against the lengthwise movement caused by repeated braking.
entries.zh: 防爬轨锚抵抗反复制动引起的钢轨纵向位移。

entries.meaningZh: 抗箭毒药；拮抗箭毒对肌肉作用的化学药剂
entries.en: The pharmacologist tested an anticurare against the muscle paralysis caused by curare.
entries.zh: 药理学家针对箭毒引起的肌肉麻痹，测试了一种抗箭毒药。

entries.meaningZh: 反重氮酸盐；染整术语表所称由重氮盐稳定化形成的化合物
entries.en: The chemist compared the antidiazotate with the original diazonium salt in a stability test.
entries.zh: 化学家通过稳定性测试，比较了该反重氮酸盐与原来的重氮盐。

entries.meaningZh: 抗利尿激素；vasopressin（加压素）的同义名
entries.en: The physiologist measured antidiuretin while studying how the body conserved water.
entries.zh: 生理学家研究身体如何保水时，测量了抗利尿激素。

entries.meaningZh: 逆阻力的；抵抗机翼向前受力的（本例为机翼内部张线）
entries.en: The mechanic checked the antidrag wires that brace the wing against forward loads.
entries.zh: 机械师检查了抵抗机翼向前载荷的逆阻力张线。

entries.meaningZh: 抵抗外加能量的；对施加的能量产生阻抗的
entries.en: The lecturer described friction as an antienergistic influence that opposes the applied effort.
entries.zh: 讲师将摩擦描述为一种对外加能量起抵抗作用、阻碍所施加作用力的因素。

entries.meaningZh: 反娱乐的；有意抵制常规娱乐方式或取悦观众的（实验戏剧语境）
entries.en: The director's anti-entertainment approach denied the audience an easy story or a comfortable ending.
entries.zh: 导演的反娱乐取向没有给观众提供一个轻松易懂的故事或舒适的结局。

entries.meaningZh: 反环境；使人察觉惯常环境中隐含特征的对照性情境或艺术作品（McLuhan 用语）
entries.en: Her sound installation became an anti-environment, making visitors notice the office noises they usually ignored.
entries.zh: 她的声音装置成为一种反环境艺术作品，使参观者注意到平时忽略的办公室噪声。

entries.meaningZh: 抑制发酵的（本例为旨在减少肠道发酵的饮食）
entries.en: The dietitian checked whether the antifermentative diet supplied enough energy and protein.
entries.zh: 营养师检查了这种旨在抑制肠道发酵的饮食是否提供了足够的能量和蛋白质。

entries.meaningZh: 稳压缓冲器；减小燃气管路压力波动的装置（本例为旧燃气装置）
entries.en: The engineer examined the antifluctuator after repeated gas-pressure surges made the burner flicker.
entries.zh: 反复的燃气压力波动使火焰闪烁后，工程师检查了稳压缓冲器。

entries.meaningZh: 抗幻觉药；WHO 旧药物分类索引中使用的药物类别名称
entries.en: The old drug index assigned a separate code to an antihallucinogen.
entries.zh: 那份旧药物索引给抗幻觉药分配了单独的代码。

entries.meaningZh: 抗交流哼声的；用于减少接地回路等造成的低频哼声的
entries.en: The teacher tried the anti-hum switch when the computer connection produced a low buzz.
entries.zh: 电脑连接产生低沉的哼声时，老师试用了抗哼声开关。

entries.meaningZh: 抗高脂蛋白血症的；用于对抗血中脂蛋白异常升高的（本例修饰药物）
entries.en: The pharmacist reviewed the antihyperlipoproteinemia drugs listed in the discharge summary.
entries.zh: 药剂师核查了出院小结列出的抗高脂蛋白血症药物。

entries.meaningZh: 抗白细胞毒素抗体；早期免疫学中能抑制 leucotoxin 作用的抗体
entries.en: The early experiment tested whether antileucotoxin could block the leucotoxin's destructive action on white blood cells.
entries.zh: 那项早期实验检验了抗白细胞毒素抗体能否阻断白细胞毒素对白细胞的破坏作用。

entries.meaningZh: 酒石酸氧锑钾铵；旧称 antiluetin 的含锑化合物，历史上曾用于梅毒治疗
entries.en: The old dispensary inventory recorded antiluetin separately from the sodium antimonyl tartrate.
entries.zh: 那份旧药房清单把酒石酸氧锑钾铵与酒石酸氧锑钠分开记录。

entries.meaningZh: 安替莫散；曾用于抗寄生虫治疗研究的含锑制剂（历史药名）
entries.en: She compared the recorded reactions to Antimosan with those reported for the other antimony preparations.
entries.zh: 她将记录中的安替莫散使用后反应，与其他锑制剂所报告的反应作了比较。

entries.meaningZh: 除臭剂；抵消或减轻臭味的制品（本例为个人除臭用品）
entries.en: She chose an unscented antiodorant because strong perfumes irritated her.
entries.zh: 她选择了无香型除臭剂，因为浓烈的香味会使她感到不适。

entries.meaningZh: 抗虱药；对虱有效的物质
entries.en: The pharmacist checked the ingredients before classifying the lotion as an antipediculotic.
entries.zh: 药剂师核对成分后，才把这种洗剂归为抗虱药。

entries.meaningZh: 词义反用的；用本义相反的词表达的
entries.en: Her antiphrastic description of the wreck as a masterpiece made her criticism unmistakable.
entries.zh: 她用“杰作”来反说那件失败之作，使批评之意显而易见。

entries.meaningZh: 抗毒化的；抵抗催化剂中毒失活的（本例为一氧化碳毒化）
entries.en: The team compared the antipoisoning catalysts under increasing concentrations of carbon monoxide.
entries.zh: 研究小组在逐渐升高的一氧化碳浓度下比较了这些抗毒化催化剂。

entries.meaningZh: antipolo 树；菲律宾的桑科树种 Artocarpus blancoi（本例取树木名）
entries.en: The nursery kept an antipolo sapling with its other native trees.
entries.zh: 苗圃把一株 antipolo 幼树与其他本土树木放在一起。

entries.meaningZh: 抗增殖；对细胞增殖的抑制
entries.en: The experiment measured antiproliferation separately from cell death.
entries.zh: 实验将抑制细胞增殖与细胞死亡分别测量。

entries.meaningZh: 防扩裂的；阻止裂口继续延伸的（本例为手术缝合）
entries.en: The surgeon placed an antipropagation stitch to stop the split from extending farther.
entries.zh: 外科医生加了一针防扩裂缝合，以阻止裂口进一步延伸。

entries.meaningZh: 像古物研究者一样考察、研究古物（较旧式用语）
entries.en: He liked to antiquarianize among the ruins instead of hurrying to the next town.
entries.zh: 他喜欢像古物研究者一样在遗迹间考察，而不是匆匆赶往下一个城镇。

entries.meaningZh: 陈旧、过时的性质或状态
entries.en: The antiquatedness of the filing system became clear when no one could locate a single receipt.
entries.zh: 没有人能找到哪怕一张收据，这才显出了那套归档系统的陈旧。

entries.meaningZh: 反向反应；要求朝目标运动方向的反方向移动的视觉运动任务（本例选实验心理学义）
entries.en: Learning antireaction required her to move her hand opposite to the target's motion.
entries.zh: 学习反向反应要求她的手向目标运动的相反方向移动。

entries.meaningZh: 反地租者；尤指十九世纪纽约州反对缴纳庄园地租的人
entries.en: The chapter follows an antirenter who joined the protests against the collection of manorial rents.
entries.zh: 这一章讲述了一位反地租者参加抗议征收庄园地租的经历。

entries.meaningZh: 反致敏治疗；旧过敏病研究中 Theurer 所提出的对抗致敏方法（不等同于笼统的脱敏疗法）
entries.en: The old case report described antisensitization, then recorded whether the allergic symptoms changed.
entries.zh: 那份旧病例报告描述了反致敏治疗，随后记录过敏症状是否发生变化。

entries.meaningZh: 通过使用抗菌或防腐消毒剂地（本例为旧医疗用语）
entries.en: The historical manual required the instruments to be treated antiseptically before use.
entries.zh: 那本历史手册要求，器械使用前须用防腐消毒剂处理。

entries.meaningZh: 反结构；通常社会等级暂时弱化、出现平等共同感的状态（Turner 仪式理论用语）
entries.en: During the rite's anti-structure, ordinary ranks briefly gave way to a sense of equality.
entries.zh: 在仪式的反结构状态中，平常的等级一时让位于平等感。

entries.meaningZh: 弄蝶科雄性抱器上 stylifer 的突起（昆虫生殖器形态术语，旧译前尾片）
entries.en: The drawing clearly separated the antistyle from the rest of the male skipper's valva.
entries.zh: 图中清楚地将雄弄蝶抱器上的 antistyle 突起与其余部分区分开来。

entries.meaningZh: 抗交感神经的；减弱交感神经系统作用的
entries.en: The review grouped the antisympathetic drugs according to how they reduced sympathetic activity.
entries.zh: 综述按照减弱交感神经活动的方式，对抗交感神经药物进行了分类。

entries.meaningZh: 抗交感神经素；曾用于降压治疗的抗交感神经制剂（历史药名）
entries.en: The old chart recorded the patient's blood pressure each day during treatment with antisympathin.
entries.zh: 那张旧病历表记录了患者使用抗交感神经素治疗期间每天的血压。

entries.meaningZh: 反同步；两个开关交替处于相反通断状态的时序关系（本例为继电器）
entries.en: The two relays worked in antisynchronism: one opened as the other closed.
entries.zh: 两个继电器按相反时序工作：一个断开时，另一个闭合。

entries.meaningZh: 反模板分子；研究中用来拮抗模板作用的部分硫代核酸大分子
entries.en: A separate assay checked whether the antitemplate could compete with DNA for binding to the enzyme.
entries.zh: 另一项测定检验了该反模板分子能否与 DNA 竞争结合该酶。

entries.meaningZh: 抗破伤风溶血素抗体；针对 tetanolysin 的抗毒素
entries.en: The technician coupled antitetanolysin to ferritin for the membrane-labeling experiment.
entries.zh: 技术员将抗破伤风溶血素抗体与铁蛋白偶联，用于膜标记实验。

entries.meaningZh: 抗毒素（antitoxin 的历史异体拼写）
entries.en: The old report discusses antitoxine separately from the bacterial toxin itself.
entries.zh: 那份旧报告将抗毒素与细菌毒素本身分别讨论。

entries.meaningZh: 反转子；鸟类髂骨上与股骨大转子相接的关节面
entries.en: The anatomist marked the antitrochanter on the drawing of the bird's pelvis.
entries.zh: 解剖学家在鸟类骨盆图上标出了反转子关节面。

entries.meaningZh: 抑制肿瘤发生；阻止或减少肿瘤形成的作用
entries.en: The team assessed antitumorigenesis by counting how many new tumours developed in each group.
entries.zh: 研究小组通过统计各组新出现的肿瘤数量，评估抑制肿瘤发生的作用。

entries.meaningZh: 抗春化作用；先行高温处理削弱或消除随后低温处理的促花效应
entries.en: To test antivernalization, the researchers warmed the plants before giving them the cold treatment.
entries.zh: 为检验抗春化作用，研究人员在低温处理前先对植株进行高温处理。

entries.meaningZh: 耐候性；抵抗风雨等天气影响的性能
entries.en: The coating's antiweatherability was checked after months of exposure to rain and sunlight.
entries.zh: 涂层在雨水和日光中暴露数月后，研究人员检查了其耐候性。

entries.meaningZh: 换称的；以称号代替姓名或以专名代称某类人的
entries.en: Calling the boastful student a Napoleon was an antonomastic choice.
entries.zh: 把那名自负的学生称作“拿破仑”，运用了换称修辞。

entries.meaningZh: 法兰克王公的亲随或臣属（指个人，不是整支卫队）
entries.en: The antrustion accompanied the Frankish prince on his journey.
entries.zh: 那位亲随陪伴法兰克王公出行。

entries.meaningZh: （非标准、创造性复数用法）普通人们；本例将 anyone 的复数形式用作复数名词
entries.en: Local anyones helped turn the empty shop into a library for the whole neighbourhood.
entries.zh: 当地的普通人帮忙把那间空店铺改成了一座服务整个街区的图书馆。

entries.meaningZh: 块茎旱金莲 Tropaeolum tuberosum 及其食用块茎；一种安第斯作物
entries.en: The gardener roasted a few anyu tubers from her first harvest.
entries.zh: 园丁把第一批收获的几枚块茎旱金莲块茎烤熟了。

entries.meaningZh: 性交不能；因身体或心理方面的性功能障碍而无法性交
entries.en: The questionnaire distinguished apareunia from intercourse that was possible but painful.
entries.zh: 问卷区分了不能性交和能够性交但有疼痛这两种情况。

entries.meaningZh: 冷漠；感情淡漠；缺乏兴趣和感受的状态（旧医学词，同 apathy）
entries.en: The older account called her persistent indifference to everything around her apathism.
entries.zh: 那份旧记述把她对周围一切事物持续漠不关心的状态称为感情淡漠。

entries.meaningZh: 根尖切除术；切除牙根尖端的手术（牙科教学手册所录 apicectomy/apicoectomy 同义形式）
entries.en: The specialist discussed apectomy after showing the patient the affected root tip on the image.
entries.zh: 专科医生在影像上向患者指出受累牙根尖后，讨论了根尖切除术。

entries.meaningZh: 对无穷或永恒的恐惧（本例为这种恐惧的名称，不主张其为独立临床诊断）
entries.en: A lesson about infinity unexpectedly stirred her apeirophobia.
entries.zh: 课堂上关于无限的讲解，意外地勾起了她对无穷的恐惧。

entries.meaningZh: 肠外的；本通常发生于肠道的感染或病理过程在肠外出现的（旧医学用法）
entries.en: The infection was apenteric, occurring outside its usual site in the intestine.
entries.zh: 这次感染发生在肠外，而不是通常发生的肠道部位。

entries.meaningZh: 无花瓣的状态；无瓣性
entries.en: The botanist treated apetalousness as a floral trait rather than a sign that a blossom was damaged.
entries.zh: 植物学家将无瓣性视为一种花部特征，而不是花朵受损的迹象。

entries.meaningZh: 不孕磷；曾用于昆虫化学绝育研究的化合物 aphamide
entries.en: The researcher recorded how fertility changed in insects exposed to aphamide.
entries.zh: 研究人员记录了接触不孕磷的昆虫生育能力如何变化。

entries.meaningZh: aphanesite；clinoclase 的同义名，一种单斜晶系的碱式羟基砷酸铜矿物
entries.en: The curator grouped aphanesite with the other copper arsenate minerals.
entries.zh: 馆藏管理员把 aphanesite 这种矿物与其他砷酸铜矿物归在一起。

entries.meaningZh: 非显晶基斑状的；斑晶嵌于玻璃质基质中的火成岩结构的
entries.en: Large crystals stood out against the glassy groundmass of the aphaniphyric rock.
entries.zh: 大晶体在那块非显晶基斑状岩石的玻璃质基质中格外显眼。

entries.meaningZh: 超显微生物体；小到普通显微镜无法分辨的生物体
entries.en: An aphantobiont could not be resolved with the ordinary light microscope used in the demonstration.
entries.zh: 演示中使用的普通光学显微镜无法分辨那个超显微生物体。

entries.meaningZh: 无触向反应；不对接触刺激作定向生长反应的现象
entries.en: The shoot showed aphaptotropism: touching it produced no directional growth response.
entries.zh: 这根枝条表现为无触向反应：接触刺激没有引起定向生长反应。

entries.meaningZh: 避阻性；根等转向远离所接触障碍物生长的现象（旧植物学术语）
entries.en: The seedling's root curved away from the block, showing aphercotropism.
entries.zh: 幼苗的根弯向远离挡块的一侧，表现出避阻性。

entries.meaningZh: 蚜黄液；蚜虫体内的黄色液体，aphidilutein 的异名（不假定为单一化合物）
entries.en: Under the lens, the droplet of aphideine from the aphid appeared yellow.
entries.zh: 镜下，取自那只蚜虫的一滴蚜黄液呈黄色。

entries.meaningZh: 蚜虫（较旧式名称）
entries.en: The gardener lifted a leaf and found an aphidian feeding beneath it.
entries.zh: 园丁抬起一片叶子，发现一只蚜虫正在叶背取食。

entries.meaningZh: 蚜色素类（复数）；蚜虫所具有的一组特有色素
entries.en: The team compared the aphins extracted from aphids of different colours.
entries.zh: 研究小组比较了从不同颜色的蚜虫中提取的蚜色素。

entries.meaningZh: 好堆砌格言的人；格言贩子（贬义旧词）
entries.en: The reviewer dismissed him as an aphorismer who valued clever sayings above careful argument.
entries.zh: 评论者讥称他为格言贩子，认为他重视俏皮警句甚于严谨论证。

entries.meaningZh: 缺磷症；因磷不足引起的病症（本例为牛的缺磷病）
entries.en: The veterinarian investigated aphosphorosis after several cows began chewing unusual objects.
entries.zh: 几头牛开始啃食异常物品后，兽医展开了对缺磷症的调查。

entries.meaningZh: 对光刺激不作反应的（本例取植物词典的叶片义）
entries.en: The observer described the leaf as aphotometric because it showed no response when the light was moved.
entries.zh: 观察者称那片叶对光刺激无反应，因为移动光源时它没有表现出反应。

entries.meaningZh: 组句不能；能说出单词却不能将其连成可理解话语的障碍（旧医学词义）
entries.en: The historical case report describes aphrasia despite the patient's ability to utter individual words.
entries.zh: 那份历史病例报告描述了患者虽能说出单个词，却存在组句不能。

entries.meaningZh: 痴呆（本例取 Stedman 1911 年词典所列第一义，保留历史医学用语的范围）
entries.en: The historian found aphrenia listed under dementia in the old physician's index.
entries.zh: 历史学家发现，那位旧时医生的索引将 aphrenia 归在痴呆项下。

entries.meaningZh: 鳞片状或白垩状方解石的旧称
entries.en: The collection includes aphrite beside several crystalline varieties of calcite.
entries.zh: 那批藏品中，鳞片状或白垩状方解石与几种结晶方解石并列陈放。

entries.meaningZh: 对寻找能增强性活动的手段或物质的病态执着（本例取阿塞拜疆卫生部门术语表所列义）
entries.en: He spent his savings chasing supposed sexual stimulants, an obsession described as aphrodisiomania.
entries.zh: 他把积蓄花在追逐所谓的性兴奋剂上，这种执着被称为对增强性活动手段的病态追求。

entries.meaningZh: 阿佛洛狄忒女神的雕像（复数；以女神名转指其雕像）
entries.en: The gallery displayed three Aphrodites carved in different types of marble.
entries.zh: 展厅陈列了三尊用不同种类大理石雕成的阿佛洛狄忒女神像。

entries.meaningZh: 填充火成岩空腔的绿泥石的旧名；可能相当于 chamosite（旧译铁绿泥石）
entries.en: The old specimen label called the chlorite filling the rock's cavities aphrosiderite.
entries.zh: 那张旧标本标签把填充岩石空腔的绿泥石称为 aphrosiderite。

entries.meaningZh: 成碎片地；散成碎片地（废弃旧义，不是 apiece 的规范复数）
entries.en: The wooden frame came apieces as soon as he lifted it.
entries.zh: 他一抬起那副木框，木框就散架了。

entries.meaningZh: Apiserum；用于含蜂王浆等产品的品牌名（本例为蜂王浆口服安瓿制剂）
entries.en: She recognised the Apiserum name on the box of royal-jelly ampoules.
entries.zh: 她认出了那盒蜂王浆口服安瓿制剂上的 Apiserum 品牌名。

entries.meaningZh: 无板类；没有贝壳板片的一类软体动物（本例不限定现行分类阶元）
entries.en: The old classification separates Aplacophora from the molluscs bearing shell plates.
entries.zh: 旧分类将无板类与具有贝壳板片的软体动物区分开来。

entries.meaningZh: 单纯切开术（旧外科学用语）
entries.en: The glossary distinguishes aplotomy, a simple incision, from the removal of tissue.
entries.zh: 术语表将单纯切开术与组织切除区分开来。

entries.meaningZh: 导致细胞或组织减损的（无脊椎动物词典所录生物学义）
entries.en: Apobiotic changes had left only a thin layer of the original tissue.
entries.zh: 细胞或组织减损性变化使原有组织只剩下很薄的一层。

entries.meaningZh: 相信或宣扬世界末日即将到来的人（复数；历史宗教思想用语）
entries.en: The village's apocalyptics interpreted the eclipse as a warning that the end was near.
entries.zh: 村里的末世论者把那次日食解读为末日将近的警告。

entries.meaningZh: 肌肉易疲劳；随着反复用力而出现肌力耗竭的现象
entries.en: Her first few lifts were easy, but apocamnosis soon made the same movement difficult.
entries.zh: 她最初几次抬举还很轻松，但肌肉易疲劳很快就让同样的动作变得困难。

entries.meaningZh: 阿朴可待因；由可待因制得的一种生物碱
entries.en: The study compares apocodeine with the codeine from which it was prepared.
entries.zh: 研究将阿朴可待因与制取它所用的可待因进行了比较。

entries.meaningZh: 词尾省略；删去词末字母或音节的过程
entries.en: The linguist used apocopation to explain the loss of the final syllable.
entries.zh: 语言学家用词尾省略来解释最后一个音节的消失。

entries.meaningZh: 无壁多核原生质团；不由细胞壁分隔、含有多个细胞核的原生质团
entries.en: Staining revealed several nuclei within the apocytium's undivided mass of cytoplasm.
entries.zh: 染色后，那个无壁多核原生质团中未分隔的细胞质内可见数个细胞核。

entries.meaningZh: 不能使用手指的；手指功能丧失的
entries.en: An apodactylic patient could move his arm but could not use his fingers to fasten a button.
entries.zh: 那名手指功能丧失的患者能活动手臂，却不能用手指扣上纽扣。

entries.meaningZh: 无足动物；没有足或足状器官的动物（旧动物学用语）
entries.en: The old zoology text treats the worm as an apode, an animal without feet.
entries.zh: 那本旧动物学教材将蠕虫视为无足动物，即没有足的动物。

entries.meaningZh: 无可置疑的；不容否认的
entries.en: The philosopher demanded apodeictical certainty rather than a merely probable conclusion.
entries.zh: 哲学家要求无可置疑的确定性，而不是仅仅可能成立的结论。

entries.meaningZh: 无可置疑地；以不容反驳的方式
entries.en: The theorem was presented apodeictically, with each conclusion following from stated premises.
entries.zh: 该定理以不容反驳的方式呈现，每个结论都由明确给出的前提推出。

entries.meaningZh: 无足的；不具有腿或足的（同 apodal，本例取动物形态义）
entries.en: The apodial larva moved forward by contracting its body.
entries.zh: 那只无足幼虫通过收缩身体向前移动。

entries.meaningZh: 无足动物；没有足或足状器官的动物（复数）
entries.en: The account separates apods from animals bearing functional feet.
entries.zh: 那份记述将无足动物与具有功能性足的动物分开讨论。

entries.meaningZh: 交代改造花岗岩；由花岗岩受到交代作用改造而形成的岩石
entries.en: The geologist compared the apogranite with nearby granite that had escaped the same alteration.
entries.zh: 地质学家将交代改造花岗岩与附近未受同类改造的花岗岩作了比较。

entries.meaningZh: 远女症；旧精神病理术语中回避接近女性的状态（依1935年国立编译馆名词表）
entries.en: The biographer described his retreat from the company of women as apogyny.
entries.zh: 传记作者将他回避与女性交往的行为称为远女症。

entries.meaningZh: 平衡着；处于平衡状态地（旧用语）
entries.en: He held the long pole apoise while crossing the narrow beam.
entries.zh: 他走过狭窄的横梁时，让长杆保持平衡。

entries.meaningZh: 易疲劳；很快便感到极度疲倦的状态（本例取马来西亚官方医学术语表第一义）
entries.en: Apokamnosis left him exhausted after a short walk across the room.
entries.zh: 易疲劳的症状使他只在房间里走了一小段就筋疲力尽。

entries.meaningZh: 无极性；缺少明显的极性分布（本例为细胞内蛋白质分布失去极性）
entries.en: The images revealed apolarity in several older stem cells, with tubulin spread throughout rather than concentrated at one side.
entries.zh: 图像显示，几个较衰老的干细胞失去了极性：微管蛋白分散在细胞各处，而不是集中于一侧。

entries.meaningZh: 距岩浆源中等距离的（用于热液矿床的旧分类术语）
entries.en: The report distinguished the apomagmatic deposit from deposits much farther from the magma source.
entries.zh: 报告将这个距岩浆源中等距离的热液矿床，与远离岩浆源的矿床区分开来。

entries.meaningZh: 测高仪；用于测量物体高度的仪器（旧仪器名称）
entries.en: The surveyor used an apomecometer to estimate the height of the tower.
entries.zh: 测量员用一台旧式测高仪估测那座塔的高度。

entries.meaningZh: 衍生性状状态；相对于祖先状态而演化出的性状状态（支序分类学义）
entries.en: Within this lineage, the loss of the tail was scored as an apomorph.
entries.zh: 在这个谱系中，尾的丧失被记为一种衍生性状状态。

entries.meaningZh: 减轻疼痛的；止痛的（旧医学用语）
entries.en: In the old letter, the doctor praises the aponic effect of a warm bath.
entries.zh: 在那封旧信中，医生称赞热水浴的止痛作用。

entries.meaningZh: 受他人在场影响而改变行为的（心理学术语）
entries.en: The boy's apopathetic behaviour began the moment he realised the other children were watching.
entries.zh: 男孩一意识到其他孩子正在看他，就开始做出受旁人在场影响的表现性举动。

entries.meaningZh: 祛痰剂（旧医学用语）
entries.en: The old prescription combines an apophlegmatisant with a soothing syrup.
entries.zh: 那张旧处方将一种祛痰剂与舒缓性的糖浆合用。

entries.meaningZh: 具膨大蒴托的（植物学，本例指苔藓的孢蒴）
entries.en: The moss's apophysate capsule was easiest to recognise in side view.
entries.zh: 从侧面观察，最容易辨认那株苔藓带有膨大蒴托的孢蒴。

entries.meaningZh: 骨突部病变；骨突病（医学）
entries.en: The specialist distinguished apophyseopathy from an injury to the joint itself.
entries.zh: 专科医生把骨突部病变与关节本身的损伤区分开来。

entries.meaningZh: 生长于受人类干扰生境的本地植物（植物生态学）
entries.en: The survey counted the native plant colonising the abandoned yard as an apophyte.
entries.zh: 调查把迁入那处废弃院落的本地植物记为一种生长于人为干扰生境的原生植物。

entries.meaningZh: 不形成典型原质团的（生物学）
entries.en: The diagram contrasts an apoplasmodial stage with one in which the cells fuse into a plasmodium.
entries.zh: 图示对比了不形成典型原质团的阶段与细胞融合成原质团的阶段。

entries.meaningZh: 引起卒中或中风的（旧医学用语）
entries.en: The old physician described the patient's way of life as apoplectigenous.
entries.zh: 那位老医生把病人的生活方式描述为可能引起中风的。

entries.meaningZh: 阿朴奎胺碱；由奎胺经酸处理产生的生物碱
entries.en: The historical experiment produced apoquinamine by heating quinamine with hydrochloric acid.
entries.zh: 那项历史实验通过将奎胺与盐酸一同加热，制得了阿朴奎胺碱。

entries.meaningZh: 大黄泻脂；从大黄提取的泻性树脂（旧药学）
entries.en: The pharmacognosy lesson distinguished aporetin from the other substances extracted from rhubarb.
entries.zh: 生药学课把大黄泻脂与从大黄中提取的其他物质作了区分。

entries.meaningZh: 焦虑性神经症；焦虑或疑虑神经症（旧医学术语）
entries.en: The historian explained why aporioneurosis appears in the early psychiatric case notes.
entries.zh: 历史学者解释了为什么早期精神科病例笔记中会出现“焦虑性神经症”这一旧称。

entries.meaningZh: 头部难以辨别的（旧生物医学用语）
entries.en: The illustrator enlarged the front end of the aporocephalous animal to make its head easier to distinguish.
entries.zh: 插画师放大了那只头部难以辨别的动物的前端，使其头部更容易辨认。

entries.meaningZh: 裂衍物；氨基酸在生物体内转变形成的代谢衍生产物（历史生化术语）
entries.en: The diagram follows an amino acid through decarboxylation to its aporrhegma.
entries.zh: 图示追踪了一种氨基酸脱羧形成裂衍物的过程。

entries.meaningZh: 阿朴藏红；一种吩嗪系染料化合物
entries.en: The chemists compared aposafranine with phenosafranine to examine the difference in their structures.
entries.zh: 化学家们比较了阿朴藏红与酚藏红，以研究两者结构上的差异。

entries.meaningZh: 阿朴藏红酮；一种吩嗪酮类化合物
entries.en: Heating aposafranine with concentrated hydrochloric acid produced aposafranone in the historical experiment.
entries.zh: 在那项历史实验中，将阿朴藏红与浓盐酸一同加热，制得了阿朴藏红酮。

entries.meaningZh: 石英岩；变质砂岩（旧岩石学名称）
entries.en: The old report describes the ridge as aposandstone and traces its origin to sandstone.
entries.zh: 旧报告把那道山脊描述为石英岩，并指出它是由砂岩形成的。

entries.meaningZh: 远土点；绕土星轨道上距土星最远的点
entries.en: In the orbital simulation, the moon was farthest from Saturn at aposaturnium.
entries.zh: 在轨道模拟中，那颗卫星在远土点时离土星最远。

entries.meaningZh: 沉积后生的；由沉积原岩经后期变化形成的（地质学用语）
entries.en: The geologist marked the aposedimentary rocks separately from the granite on her map.
entries.zh: 地质学家在图上将沉积后生岩石与花岗岩分别标示出来。

entries.meaningZh: 远月点；绕月轨道上距月球最远的点
entries.en: The revised lunar orbit had a higher aposelenium but the same periselenium.
entries.zh: 修正后的绕月轨道远月点高度更高，近月点则保持不变。

entries.meaningZh: 口渴感缺失；不渴（医学旧称）
entries.en: The clinical record notes aposia despite the patient's dry mouth.
entries.zh: 临床记录提到，病人虽然口干，却没有口渴感。

entries.meaningZh: 厌食；对食物的厌恶（旧医学术语）
entries.en: The nurse recorded apositia when even the smell of soup made him turn away.
entries.zh: 护士记录了他的厌食情况：他一闻到汤的气味就把头转开。

entries.meaningZh: 胞质小体；源于细胞自身活动的胞质包涵物
entries.en: As the cell changed, a dark aposome became visible within its cytoplasm.
entries.zh: 随着细胞发生变化，细胞质内显现出一个深色的胞质小体。

entries.meaningZh: 离座种子类；与胎座分开形成的种子（MacMillan 1902年历史结构分类，复数）
entries.en: MacMillan classified seeds formed separately from the placenta as aposperms.
entries.zh: 麦克米伦把与胎座分开形成的种子归为离座种子类。

entries.meaningZh: 脓肿（旧医学用语）
entries.en: An apostasis near the jaw made it difficult for the patient to chew.
entries.zh: 下颌附近的一处脓肿使病人咀嚼困难。

entries.meaningZh: 脓肿（apostema 的旧体）
entries.en: The barber-surgeon feared that the apostem would burst before morning.
entries.zh: 理发兼外科医生担心那处脓肿会在天亮前破溃。

entries.meaningZh: 植物浸剂久煮或接触空气后形成的棕色沉淀物（旧药学）
entries.en: Prolonged heating left a brown apotheme at the bottom of the herbal infusion.
entries.zh: 长时间加热后，草药浸剂底部留下了棕色沉淀物。

entries.meaningZh: 阿普西辛；一种历史上使用的局部麻醉药
entries.en: The dentist waited for the apothesine to take effect before beginning the extraction.
entries.zh: 牙医等阿普西辛起效后才开始拔牙。

entries.meaningZh: 公共浴场附设的更衣室（古代建筑用语）
entries.en: The reconstructed Roman bath includes an apothesis where visitors could leave their clothes.
entries.zh: 复原的罗马浴场设有一间更衣室，来访者可以在那里存放衣物。

entries.meaningZh: 脐带还纳器（历史产科器械）
entries.en: The obstetric museum kept an apotheter among its instruments for dealing with a prolapsed cord.
entries.zh: 产科博物馆收藏了一件脐带还纳器，作为处理脐带脱垂的器械之一。

entries.meaningZh: 两个自身不可公度、但平方可公度的量之差（古典数学）
entries.en: The teacher used √2 − 1 as a simple example of an apotome.
entries.zh: 老师用√2−1作为两个自身不可公度、但平方可公度的量之差的简单例子。

entries.meaningZh: 过敏毒素（里歇历史假说中反应产生的假想毒物）
entries.en: Richet used apotoxin for a hypothetical poison produced during anaphylaxis.
entries.zh: 里歇用“过敏毒素”来指过敏反应过程中产生的一种假想毒性物质。

entries.meaningZh: 角膜翳或角膜瘢痕的清除术（医学术语）
entries.en: After apotripsis, the surgeon checked the cornea for any remaining opacity.
entries.zh: 角膜翳清除术后，外科医生检查角膜是否仍有混浊。

entries.meaningZh: 在一端生长的（旧医学用语，用于某些细胞）
entries.en: The drawing shows an apotrophic cell growing at one end.
entries.zh: 图中显示了一个在一端生长的细胞。

entries.meaningZh: 补模标本；用于后续补充描述或图示的非命名模式标本
entries.en: The later redescription used an apotype that was not part of the original type series.
entries.zh: 后来的重新描述采用了一份补模标本，该标本不属于原始模式系列。

entries.meaningZh: 偏离典型的；异于原型的（生物学）
entries.en: Its apotypic wing pattern led the biologist to compare it with a larger series.
entries.zh: 偏离典型的翅纹促使生物学家将它与更大的一组标本进行比较。

entries.meaningZh: 牙周袋内清除出的物质；牙周刮出物（旧牙科术语）
entries.en: The old periodontal report describes the apoxemena removed from the deep pocket around the tooth.
entries.zh: 那份旧牙周报告描述了从牙齿周围深牙周袋内清除出的物质。

entries.meaningZh: apparatus（器械；装置）的缩写
entries.en: The maintenance chart shortens apparatus to APPAR to fit the column.
entries.zh: 维护表把apparatus（器械装置）缩写为APPAR，以适应栏宽。

entries.meaningZh: 器械；装置（apparatus 的过度类推复数；规范写法通常为 apparatuses 或 apparatus）
entries.en: The editor replaced "apparati" with "apparatuses" throughout the laboratory manual.
entries.zh: 编辑把实验室手册中所有“apparati”都改成了“apparatuses”。

entries.meaningZh: 器械疗法；借助机械装置进行的治疗（旧称）
entries.en: The rehabilitation ward used apparatotherapy to move the injured joint through a controlled range.
entries.zh: 康复病房采用器械疗法，让受伤关节在受控范围内活动。

entries.meaningZh: 给……穿衣；装扮（apparel 的古拼写）
entries.en: They would apparell the messenger in the duke's colours before sending him to court.
entries.zh: 他们会先让信使穿上公爵徽色的衣服，再派他去宫廷。

entries.meaningZh: 附属物；附带于某地产的权益（古语）
entries.en: The charter treated the fishing right as an appendance to the estate.
entries.zh: 这份特许状把捕鱼权视为该庄园的一项附带权益。

entries.meaningZh: 附属状态；依附关系（古语）
entries.en: The chapel's appendence to the abbey is clear from the connecting cloister.
entries.zh: 从连接两者的回廊可以看出，小礼拜堂在结构上附属于修道院。

entries.meaningZh: 附属关系；附属于某地产的状态（古语）
entries.en: The dispute concerned the cottage's appendency to the larger estate.
entries.zh: 争议的焦点是那座小屋是否附属于较大的庄园。

entries.meaningZh: Appendicularia属；尾海鞘类的一个属（动物属名）
entries.en: The illustration compares Appendicularia with other genera of free-swimming tunicates.
entries.zh: 插图将Appendicularia属与其他自由游泳的被囊动物属作了比较。

entries.meaningZh: 切题地；贴切地；适当地（罕见）
entries.en: She cited "haste makes waste" applicably after the rushed repair failed.
entries.zh: 匆忙进行的修理失败后，她很贴切地引用了“欲速则不达”这句谚语。

entries.meaningZh: 以切合实际应用的方式；以适用的方式（罕见）
entries.en: She interpreted the rule applicatively, relating it to the dispute before the panel.
entries.zh: 她以切合实际应用的方式解释规则，把它与评审小组面前的争议联系起来。

entries.meaningZh: 通过联系实际应用的方式（古语）
entries.en: At the sermon's close, he spoke applicatorily, urging listeners to practise the lesson at home.
entries.zh: 讲道结束时，他以联系实际应用的方式讲话，敦促听众在家中践行这番教诲。

entries.meaningZh: APPO；奥博金数码产品品牌（本例为该品牌的旧音乐播放器）
entries.en: He found an old APPO music player in the drawer and checked whether it still worked.
entries.zh: 他在抽屉里找到一台旧APPO牌音乐播放器，便检查它还能不能使用。

entries.meaningZh: 告知；通知（较罕见）
entries.en: She asked for prompt apprisal of any change in the sailing date.
entries.zh: 她要求一旦开航日期有变动就立即告知她。

entries.meaningZh: 估价；财产价值评估（旧用）
entries.en: The heir challenged the apprizement of the house, arguing that the valuation was too low.
entries.zh: 继承人对房屋估价提出异议，认为估值太低。

entries.meaningZh: 以可获认可或值得赞许的方式（罕见）
entries.en: The trustees spent the donation approvably on repairs to the public reading room.
entries.zh: 董事们把捐款用于修缮公共阅览室，这种使用方式值得认可。

entries.meaningZh: 以获人认可的方式；令人赞许地（古语）
entries.en: The apprentice performed the task approvedly, earning a nod from the master.
entries.zh: 学徒以令人认可的方式完成了任务，得到师傅点头赞许。

entries.meaningZh: 近似器；进行近似表示的人或工具
entries.en: The small network served as an approximator of the unknown function.
entries.zh: 这个小型网络充当了未知函数的近似器。

entries.meaningZh: 海胆精子中组蛋白样物质的一种历史名称
entries.en: Bang used arbasin to question whether ammonia precipitation could serve as a universal test for histones.
entries.zh: Bang以海胆组蛋白样物质arbasin为例，质疑氨沉淀反应能否作为鉴定组蛋白的通用试验。

entries.meaningZh: 草莓树（Arbutus unedo）种子产物的一种旧名
entries.en: The historian linked the old mention of arbusterol to the seeds of Arbutus unedo, the strawberry tree.
entries.zh: 历史研究者将arbusterol的那项旧记载与草莓树（Arbutus unedo）的种子联系起来。

entries.meaningZh: 阿达铝合金；一种旧英国铝合金的名称
entries.en: In the 1939 alloy guide, Ardal appears as an aluminium alloy containing copper, iron and nickel.
entries.zh: 在那份1939年的合金指南中，阿达铝合金被列为一种含铜、铁和镍的铝合金。

entries.meaningZh: 有线电视系统（本例不指机械索具系统）
entries.en: The village cable system carried only a handful of television channels.
entries.zh: 村里的有线电视系统只传送少量电视频道。

entries.meaningZh: 驼毛织物；用驼绒制成的布料（本例不单指动物毛发）
entries.en: The tailor recommended camel's hair for the winter coat.
entries.zh: 裁缝建议用驼毛织物制作那件冬大衣。

entries.meaningZh: 炮弹；尤指旧式实心球形炮弹（本例不是抱膝跳水动作）
entries.en: A rusty cannon ball lay in the display case beside a fragment of the old gun.
entries.zh: 一枚生锈的球形炮弹放在展柜中，旁边是一块旧炮的残片。

entries.meaningZh: 可判处死刑的罪行（不是死刑这一刑罚本身；美式拼写）
entries.en: The novel is set in a kingdom where stealing food is a capital offense.
entries.zh: 小说设定在一个偷窃食物可被判处死刑的王国。

entries.meaningZh: 纸牌魔术（本例不指打牌策略）
entries.en: Her card trick ended with the missing queen appearing inside a sealed envelope.
entries.zh: 她的纸牌魔术以那张消失的皇后牌出现在密封信封中而结束。

entries.meaningZh: 富裕顾客群；来自富裕顾客的生意
entries.en: The shop depended on the carriage trade and rarely advertised discounts.
entries.zh: 那家店依赖富裕顾客群，几乎从不宣传打折。

entries.meaningZh: 表面硬化钢（不限定采用渗碳这一种处理方法）
entries.en: The gear was made from case-hardened steel so that its surface would resist wear.
entries.zh: 那个齿轮用表面硬化钢制成，以使其表面耐磨。

entries.meaningZh: 酪蛋白颜料；以酪蛋白作黏合剂的涂料（不是酪酸涂料）
entries.en: The artist tested the casein paint on a spare board before starting the mural.
entries.zh: 画家在开始画壁画之前，先在一块备用板上试用了酪蛋白颜料。

entries.meaningZh: 把筹码兑成现金（本例为字面义，不指死亡）
entries.en: Before leaving the casino, he decided to cash in his chips.
entries.zh: 离开赌场前，他决定把筹码兑成现金。

entries.meaningZh: 腰果（可食用的种仁）
entries.en: She picked a cashew nut out of the bowl and examined its curved shape.
entries.zh: 她从碗里拿出一颗腰果，仔细看了看它弯曲的形状。

entries.meaningZh: 猫砂盆（本例不是体育项目中的沙土障碍）
entries.en: They placed the cat box in a quiet corner away from the food bowls.
entries.zh: 他们把猫砂盆放在一个安静的角落，远离食盆。

entries.meaningZh: 牛的繁育；牛的育种（不是全部畜牧业）
entries.en: The course covers cattle breeding as well as the feeding of adult animals.
entries.zh: 这门课程既讲牛的繁育，也讲成年动物的饲养。

entries.meaningZh: 运牛铁路货车；铁路牲畜车厢（不是公路拖车）
entries.en: The railway museum had restored a wooden cattle car with slatted sides.
entries.zh: 铁路博物馆修复了一节两侧由木条构成的木制运牛车厢。

entries.meaningZh: 赶牛路线；供牛群通行的路径（不是运畜拖车）
entries.en: The walkers followed an old cattle trail across the valley.
entries.zh: 徒步者沿着一条旧赶牛路线穿过山谷。

entries.meaningZh: 天球仪；标示恒星等位置的球形模型（不等同于浑天仪）
entries.en: The guide turned the celestial globe until the constellation faced us.
entries.zh: 导游转动天球仪，直到那个星座朝向我们。

entries.meaningZh: 细胞器（细胞内的特化结构，不是身体器官）
entries.en: The mitochondrion is a cell organelle, not a separate organism.
entries.zh: 线粒体是一种细胞器，不是独立的生物体。

entries.meaningZh: 早餐麦片碗；盛早餐谷物的碗
entries.en: He rinsed the cereal bowl and left it beside the sink.
entries.zh: 他冲洗了早餐麦片碗，把它放在水槽旁。

entries.meaningZh: 保温餐炉；有热源使食物保持温热的盛菜器（不是通常所说的火锅）
entries.en: The hotel kept the rice warm in a chafing dish during the lunch service.
entries.zh: 午餐供餐期间，酒店用保温餐炉让米饭保持温热。

entries.meaningZh: 礼仪御座；正式场合使用的尊贵座椅（本例不指元首职务）
entries.en: The ruler's chair of state stood under a canopy at the end of the hall.
entries.zh: 统治者的礼仪御座放在大厅尽头的华盖下面。

entries.meaningZh: 擦拭用的柔软吸水熟皮；麂皮类擦拭皮革（chamois leather 的俗拼）
entries.en: He polished the mirror with a piece of chammy leather.
entries.zh: 他用一块柔软的麂皮类擦拭皮革擦亮了镜子。

entries.meaningZh: 退房截止时间（酒店语境，不指清除或清扫时间）
entries.en: We asked whether the hotel's checkout time could be extended by an hour.
entries.zh: 我们询问能否把酒店的退房截止时间延后一小时。

entries.meaningZh: 国际象棋俱乐部（chess 指国际象棋，不是中国象棋 xiangqi）
entries.en: The chess club welcomed complete beginners and lent them boards and pieces.
entries.zh: 国际象棋俱乐部欢迎零基础的新手，并把棋盘和棋子借给他们。

entries.meaningZh: 一套国际象棋棋具（棋盘及全套棋子，不是一盘比赛）
entries.en: One knight was missing from the wooden chess set.
entries.zh: 那套木制国际象棋棋具少了一枚马。

entries.meaningZh: 炖鸡；鸡肉炖菜（不限定为法式奶油炖鸡）
entries.en: The chicken stew simmered slowly while she set the table.
entries.zh: 她摆放餐具时，鸡肉炖菜正用小火慢炖着。

entries.meaningZh: 鸡翅（本例为食物义，不指体育中的锁臂动作）
entries.en: A single chicken wing remained on the serving plate.
entries.zh: 餐盘里只剩下一只鸡翅。

entries.meaningZh: 引体向上（体育名词，通常写作 chin-up，不是鼓励用语）
entries.en: He managed one chin-up before his arms began to shake.
entries.zh: 他勉强做完一次引体向上，胳膊便开始发抖。

entries.meaningZh: 瓷器陈列柜；餐具柜
entries.en: The fragile cups stayed in the china cabinet whenever children visited.
entries.zh: 每逢孩子们来访，那些易碎的杯子都一直放在瓷器陈列柜里。

entries.meaningZh: 一点点凿削……（本例为物理动作，不指取笑别人）
entries.en: The sculptor paused to chip at a small ridge on the stone.
entries.zh: 雕刻家停下来，一点点凿削石头上一处小小的凸起。

entries.meaningZh: 可可液块；可可浆（磨细可可仁所得的物料，不是巧克力利口酒）
entries.en: The factory cooled the chocolate liquor into solid blocks for storage.
entries.zh: 工厂把可可浆冷却成固体块以便储存。

entries.meaningZh: 词典引形；用来代表一个词位的基本词形（本例为形态学义，不是注音符号）
entries.en: Under 'went', the index points the reader to the citation form 'go'.
entries.zh: 索引在 went 项下指引读者查看其词典引形 go。

entries.meaningZh: 索赔申请表；请求赔付的表格（本例不指催询通函）
entries.en: She left the amount blank on the claim form until she could find the receipt.
entries.zh: 她暂时把索赔申请表上的金额栏留空，等找到收据再填。

entries.meaningZh: 澄清黄油；除去乳固体和水分后得到的黄油脂肪
entries.en: The cook poured the clarified butter into a clean jar after straining it.
entries.zh: 厨师过滤了澄清黄油，再把它倒进干净的罐子里。

entries.meaningZh: 陶土管；陶管（本例为管道义，不指烟斗）
entries.en: A broken clay pipe beneath the path had caused the leak.
entries.zh: 小路下面一根破裂的陶土管造成了漏水。

entries.meaningZh: 重新开始的机会；不受过去记录牵累的新起点
entries.en: The new school gave him a clean slate, without the reputation he had acquired at his old one.
entries.zh: 新学校给了他重新开始的机会，不必再背负在原学校留下的名声。

entries.meaningZh: 自以为聪明、令人有些讨厌的人（英式口语，可带讽刺）
entries.en: Don't be such a clever clogs; I only asked where the switch was.
entries.zh: 别摆出一副自以为聪明的样子，我只是问开关在哪里。

entries.meaningZh: 间距很近的；紧密排列的（通常写 close-set，不指排球动作）
entries.en: His close-set eyes gave the portrait a watchful expression.
entries.zh: 肖像中那双间距很近的眼睛，使画中人显得警觉。

entries.meaningZh: 可可脂（可可豆中的脂肪，不是椰子油）
entries.en: The chocolate maker weighed the cocoa butter separately from the sugar.
entries.zh: 巧克力制作者将可可脂与糖分开称重。

entries.meaningZh: 颜色恒常性；照明条件改变时仍把物体颜色感知为相对稳定的现象
entries.en: Color constancy helps us see a white shirt as white under different lighting.
entries.zh: 颜色恒常性帮助我们在不同照明下，仍把一件白衬衫看作白色。

entries.meaningZh: 涂色书；供人给轮廓图案填色的画册（不指已经印好颜色的图册）
entries.en: She bought a coloring book with large blank shapes for the long train journey.
entries.zh: 她为那趟漫长的火车旅行买了一本涂色书，里面有大片空白的轮廓图案。

entries.meaningZh: 彩色电视系统（不限定为逐行扫描制式）
entries.en: The engineer restored an old colour television system for the museum's demonstration.
entries.zh: 工程师修复了一套旧式彩色电视系统，供博物馆演示使用。

entries.meaningZh: 彩色显像管（本例为旧式电视机部件）
entries.en: The old television's colour tube was too heavy for him to lift alone.
entries.zh: 那台旧电视机的彩色显像管太重，他一个人抬不动。

entries.meaningZh: 联合军事行动（尤指不同国家的武装力量联合参与）
entries.en: The exhibition traced the planning of a combined operation by two allied countries.
entries.zh: 展览介绍了两个盟国联合开展一场军事行动的筹划过程。

entries.meaningZh: 开始理解、认真应对……（come to grips with；本例不是实际交手）
entries.en: She needed time to come to grips with the new timetable.
entries.zh: 她需要时间来理解并适应新的时间表。

entries.meaningZh: 意大利即兴喜剧；以固定角色和即兴表演为特点的传统戏剧形式
entries.en: Their workshop on commedia dell'arte focused on masks and improvised movement.
entries.zh: 他们的意大利即兴喜剧工作坊侧重面具和即兴动作。

entries.meaningZh: 大宗商品市场（不只包含农业，也不限定为期货交易）
entries.en: The newspaper keeps its report on the commodities market separate from its stock-market pages.
entries.zh: 这份报纸将大宗商品市场报道与股票市场版面分开。

entries.meaningZh: 严重到使人难以正常行动或运作的程度
entries.en: The rent was cripplingly high for a shop that small.
entries.zh: 对那么小的一家店来说，租金高得让人难以承受。

entries.meaningZh: 苏格兰小农场的持有和经营制度
entries.en: Crofting shaped both the landscape and the working lives of her grandparents.
entries.zh: 苏格兰小农场制度既塑造了当地景观，也影响了她祖父母的劳动生活。

entries.meaningZh: 裁剪过的；经裁切的（本例指照片）
entries.en: The cropped photograph no longer shows the sign above the door.
entries.zh: 裁剪过的照片已看不到门上方的招牌。

entries.meaningZh: 异装者；穿着传统上被视为另一性别服装的人
entries.en: The cross-dresser chose a silk dress for the costume party.
entries.zh: 那位异装者为化装舞会挑选了一件丝绸连衣裙。

entries.meaningZh: 皱巴巴的；被弄皱的
entries.en: A crumpled receipt fell out of the pocket when I shook the coat.
entries.zh: 我抖了抖外套，一张皱巴巴的收据从口袋里掉了出来。

entries.meaningZh: 取消约定；退出原先答应参加的活动（英式）
entries.en: Please let us know early if you need to cry off.
entries.zh: 如果你需要取消参加，请早点告诉我们。

entries.meaningZh: 为省时或省钱而省略必要步骤；偷工减料
entries.en: We cannot cut corners on the foundations just to finish a week earlier.
entries.zh: 我们不能仅为提前一周完工，就在地基施工上偷工减料。

entries.meaningZh: 织补；用针线修补破洞的活儿
entries.en: She did the darning by the window, where the light was better.
entries.zh: 她在光线更好的窗边做织补。

entries.meaningZh: 约会强奸；由约会对象实施的强奸
entries.en: The workshop discussed date rape and the importance of freely given consent.
entries.zh: 研讨会讨论了约会强奸，以及自愿同意的重要性。

entries.meaningZh: 赖账或逃避责任的人（贬义，亦写 deadbeat）
entries.en: She called him a dead-beat after he refused to repay the money he had borrowed.
entries.zh: 他拒绝归还借款后，她骂他是个赖账的家伙。

entries.meaningZh: 消音；减弱声音或振动的处理
entries.en: The new underlay provides sound deadening between the two flats.
entries.zh: 新铺的垫层在两套公寓之间起到了消音作用。

entries.meaningZh: 负债累累的（修正原名词标注）
entries.en: The debt-ridden club sold its training ground to pay the bills.
entries.zh: 那家负债累累的俱乐部卖掉了训练场来偿付账单。

entries.meaningZh: 明显的；明确无疑的
entries.en: The larger wheels gave the trolley a decided advantage on rough ground.
entries.zh: 较大的轮子使这辆手推车在崎岖地面上有明显优势。

entries.meaningZh: 公开表示支持
entries.en: The committee has yet to declare for either candidate.
entries.zh: 委员会尚未公开表示支持两名候选人中的任何一位。

entries.meaningZh: 单方契据（本例为证明改名的契据）
entries.en: She kept a copy of her deed poll with her other identity documents.
entries.zh: 她把一份改名契据副本与其他身份证件放在一起。

entries.meaningZh: 冷冻柜；用于深度冷冻储存的设备
entries.en: The berries went straight into the deep freeze after we sorted them.
entries.zh: 我们把浆果分拣好后，立即放进冷冻柜。

entries.meaningZh: 依……而定；视……而定（修正原形容词标注）
entries.en: The walk takes two or three hours, depending on the weather.
entries.zh: 这趟步行要花两到三个小时，具体取决于天气。

entries.meaningZh: 为……的后裔的（常与 from 连用）
entries.en: The family is descended from farmers who settled here centuries ago.
entries.zh: 这个家族是数百年前在此定居的农民的后裔。

entries.meaningZh: 甜点匙；介于茶匙和汤匙之间的匙
entries.en: He used a dessertspoon to lift the peaches out of the bowl.
entries.zh: 他用一把甜点匙把桃子从碗里舀出来。

entries.meaningZh: 减压；缓解紧张
entries.en: A quiet swim helps me destress after a crowded day.
entries.zh: 忙碌的一天过后，安静地游一会儿泳有助于我缓解压力。

entries.meaningZh: 直接统治；由中央或外部当局直接治理
entries.en: The history chapter contrasts local self-government with direct rule.
entries.zh: 这章历史内容对比了地方自治与直接统治。

entries.meaningZh: 未参与的；与某事保持距离的
entries.en: He remained disengaged from the argument and continued sorting the papers.
entries.zh: 他没有卷入争论，而是继续整理文件。

entries.meaningZh: 灰心的；气馁的（感受义，不是使别人气馁）
entries.en: The disheartened players sat in silence after the final whistle.
entries.zh: 终场哨响后，灰心的球员们默默坐着。

entries.meaningZh: 唱片节目主持人；播放录制音乐的主持人（亦写 disc jockey）
entries.en: The disk jockey played a request from a listener on the night shift.
entries.zh: 那位音乐节目主持人播放了一首夜班听众点播的歌曲。

entries.meaningZh: 使气馁；使沮丧（dispirit 的现在分词）
entries.en: The constant delays were dispiriting everyone on the project.
entries.zh: 接连不断的延误让项目里的所有人都感到气馁。

entries.meaningZh: 自以为在行善却不切实际或令人反感的人（贬义）
entries.en: The residents resented being lectured by a do-gooder who had never asked what they needed.
entries.zh: 居民们反感一个从未询问他们需求、却自以为在行善的人对他们说教。

entries.meaningZh: 器官捐献意愿卡
entries.en: He found his old donor card while clearing out his wallet.
entries.zh: 他整理钱包时找到了以前的器官捐献意愿卡。

entries.meaningZh: 务实的；脚踏实地的
entries.en: Her plans sound ambitious, but she is remarkably down to earth about the cost.
entries.zh: 她的计划听起来雄心勃勃，但她对成本的看法十分务实。

entries.meaningZh: 在澳大利亚或新西兰（非正式；修正原词性）
entries.en: They spent a year down under before returning to Canada.
entries.zh: 他们在澳大利亚和新西兰那一带住了一年，然后回到了加拿大。

entries.meaningZh: 令人精疲力竭的
entries.en: The long argument was more draining than the journey itself.
entries.zh: 那场长时间的争论比旅程本身更让人精疲力竭。

entries.meaningZh: 想不起来；未能找到答案或结果
entries.en: I usually remember faces, but I draw a blank when someone asks for a name.
entries.zh: 我通常记得面孔，可有人问起名字时，我就想不起来了。

entries.meaningZh: 憔悴的；因疲劳或忧虑而显得消瘦紧绷的
entries.en: Her face looked drawn after three nights of broken sleep.
entries.zh: 连续三个晚上没睡好，她的脸显得十分憔悴。

entries.meaningZh: 画；draw 的过去式（修正原名词标注）
entries.en: He drew a small map on the back of the envelope.
entries.zh: 他在信封背面画了一张小地图。

entries.meaningZh: 干果；经干燥处理的水果（不要求加糖）
entries.en: The porridge contained dried fruit instead of extra sugar.
entries.zh: 粥里加了水果干，没有额外加糖。

entries.meaningZh: 喝完；把剩下的饮料喝尽
entries.en: Drink up your juice before we leave for school.
entries.zh: 我们出发去学校前，把果汁喝完。

entries.meaningZh: 干腐；木材受真菌侵害而产生的腐朽
entries.en: The surveyor found dry rot beneath the damaged floorboards.
entries.zh: 勘验人员在受损的地板下面发现了干腐。

entries.meaningZh: 达姆弹；击中后易膨胀的子弹（不是靠炸药爆炸的弹丸）
entries.en: The exhibit distinguishes a dum-dum from an explosive bullet.
entries.zh: 展览区分了达姆弹与爆炸弹。

entries.meaningZh: 哑铃；两端有重物的短柄健身器械（亦写 dumbbell）
entries.en: One dumb-bell had rolled under the bench after the exercise class.
entries.zh: 健身课结束后，一只哑铃滚到了长凳下面。

entries.meaningZh: 亮电蓝色的；鲜亮的蓝色
entries.en: An electric-blue scarf stood out against her grey coat.
entries.zh: 一条亮电蓝色围巾在她的灰色外套映衬下格外醒目。

entries.meaningZh: 小精灵；elf 的复数（本例为童话生物）
entries.en: The elves in the story built their houses inside hollow trees.
entries.zh: 故事中的小精灵在空心树里建造自己的房屋。

entries.meaningZh: 整体地；一起地（修正原名词标注）
entries.en: The collection was sold en bloc rather than painting by painting.
entries.zh: 这批藏品整体售出，而不是逐幅出售。

entries.meaningZh: 全体一起；成群地（修正原动词标注）
entries.en: The children rushed outside en masse when the rain stopped.
entries.zh: 雨一停，孩子们就一窝蜂地跑到了外面。

entries.meaningZh: 使能够；使成为可能（enable 的现在分词）
entries.en: The grant is enabling us to keep the library open on Sundays.
entries.zh: 这笔资助让我们得以在星期日继续开放图书馆。

entries.meaningZh: 端区；美式橄榄球场两端的得分区
entries.en: The receiver caught the pass just inside the end zone.
entries.zh: 接球手在端区内侧不远处接住了传球。

entries.meaningZh: 机会各半的；可能性为百分之五十的（英式）
entries.en: With the two strongest teams in the final, we gave each an evens chance.
entries.zh: 实力最强的两队进入决赛，我们认为双方获胜机会各半。

entries.meaningZh: 外在特征；外表形式（复数）
entries.en: The house has changed little in its externals, although every room has been rebuilt.
entries.zh: 尽管每个房间都已重建，这栋房屋的外观却变化不大。

entries.meaningZh: 仙女教母；童话中帮助主人公的女仙人
entries.en: The fairy godmother arrived just as the girl was about to give up hope.
entries.zh: 女孩正要放弃希望时，仙女教母出现了。

entries.meaningZh: 黇鹿（Dama dama）
entries.en: A fallow deer stepped out from behind the trees and watched us cross the meadow.
entries.zh: 一只黇鹿从树后走出来，看着我们穿过草地。

entries.meaningZh: 远远地；……得多（用于强调比较的优势）
entries.en: Of all the tents we tried, this one was far and away the easiest to put up.
entries.zh: 在我们试过的所有帐篷中，这顶搭起来要容易得多。

entries.meaningZh: 病情、衰败等已发展到严重阶段的
entries.en: The old fence was too far gone to repair, so we replaced it.
entries.zh: 旧篱笆已经破败得无法修理，我们便把它换掉了。

entries.meaningZh: 快速取得进展的途径；捷径（比喻）
entries.en: The training scheme put her on the fast track to a management role.
entries.zh: 那项培训计划让她踏上了快速晋升管理岗位的道路。

entries.meaningZh: 非常健康的；身体强健的
entries.en: After a quiet weekend, she felt fighting fit again.
entries.zh: 安静地度过一个周末后，她又感到身体状态极佳。

entries.meaningZh: 地狱烈火与硫磺；关于地狱惩罚的严厉宣讲
entries.en: The sermon contained more fire and brimstone than words of comfort.
entries.zh: 那篇布道里，关于地狱惩罚的严厉宣讲多于安慰的话语。

entries.meaningZh: 消防逃生梯；供紧急逃生使用的楼外楼梯
entries.en: The fire escape ran down the outside wall to the alley.
entries.zh: 消防逃生梯沿着外墙向下通到小巷。

entries.meaningZh: 用燃烧弹攻击（firebomb 的现在分词）
entries.en: The report accused the militia of firebombing empty houses.
entries.zh: 报告指控那支民兵用燃烧弹袭击空房屋。

entries.meaningZh: 亲身地；直接地（firsthand、first-hand 的分写形式）
entries.en: She learned first hand how difficult the crossing could be.
entries.zh: 她亲身体会到了渡过那片水域可能有多么困难。

entries.meaningZh: 首先；第一（非正式）
entries.en: First off, we need to find out who has the keys.
entries.zh: 首先，我们得弄清钥匙在谁那里。

entries.meaningZh: 英国部分地区供低龄儿童就读的初级学校
entries.en: Their youngest child starts at the village first school in September.
entries.zh: 他们最小的孩子九月开始在村里的初级学校上学。

entries.meaningZh: 已标记的；已被标示以供注意的
entries.en: The flagged passages need another check before the manuscript goes to print.
entries.zh: 稿件付印前，那些已标记的段落还需要再检查一次。

entries.meaningZh: 闪光灯；照相机使用的闪光装置
entries.en: The flashgun was too bulky to fit in the camera's small carrying case.
entries.zh: 那个闪光灯太大，装不进相机的小便携包。

entries.meaningZh: 平地赛马；不跳障碍的赛马
entries.en: She prefers flat racing to races over fences.
entries.zh: 比起跳越障碍的赛马，她更喜欢平地赛马。

entries.meaningZh: 平板卡车；载货平台无固定侧板或顶棚的卡车
entries.en: A flatbed carried the damaged tractor back to the farm.
entries.zh: 一辆平板卡车把损坏的拖拉机运回了农场。

entries.meaningZh: 弹簧折刀；按动按钮便弹出刀刃的折刀（英式）
entries.en: The officer placed the confiscated flick-knife in an evidence bag.
entries.zh: 警员把没收的弹簧折刀放进了证物袋。

entries.meaningZh: 脸红的；面色潮红的
entries.en: His cheeks were flushed after the steep climb.
entries.zh: 爬完陡坡后，他的双颊泛红。

entries.meaningZh: 肥鹅肝或肥鸭肝及以其制作的食品
entries.en: The menu offered foie gras with toast and a tart fruit sauce.
entries.zh: 菜单上有配吐司和酸味果酱的肥肝料理。

entries.meaningZh: 预先使有准备（forearm 的过去式或过去分词）
entries.en: The briefing forearmed us with answers to the most likely questions.
entries.zh: 情况介绍让我们预先准备好了最可能被问到的问题的答案。

entries.meaningZh: 先于；走在……之前（forego 的过去式，文学用语）
entries.en: In the old tale, a herald forewent the king through every town.
entries.zh: 在那个古老的故事里，一名传令官先于国王穿过每一座城镇。

entries.meaningZh: 被遗忘的；不再为人记起的
entries.en: A forgotten footpath led from the ruined mill to the river.
entries.zh: 一条被人遗忘的小径从废弃磨坊通向河流。

entries.meaningZh: 强行架住胳膊押走（常见现代用法）
entries.en: The guards threatened to frog-march him out if he refused to leave.
entries.zh: 警卫威胁说，如果他不肯离开，就架住他的胳膊把他押出去。

entries.meaningZh: 满足的；因实现个人目标而感到充实的
entries.en: She felt fulfilled by work that allowed her to help people directly.
entries.zh: 能直接帮助别人的工作让她感到充实而满足。

entries.meaningZh: 充满……的（full 后接 of 补语）
entries.en: The drawer was full of buttons that matched none of my shirts.
entries.zh: 抽屉里装满了纽扣，可没有一颗配得上我的衬衫。

entries.meaningZh: 全速前进！；放手干吧！
entries.en: Full steam ahead! We have everything we need to begin.
entries.zh: 全速前进！我们已经具备开始所需的一切。

entries.meaningZh: 未稀释的；足量浓度的
entries.en: The label says to dilute the cleaner rather than use it full-strength.
entries.zh: 标签说要把清洁剂稀释后使用，而不是使用原液。

entries.meaningZh: 给……穿上衣服（garb 的过去分词，正式）
entries.en: The actors were garbed in heavy wool for the winter scene.
entries.zh: 拍摄冬季场景时，演员们穿上了厚重的毛料衣服。

entries.meaningZh: 不请自来的聚会参加者
entries.en: The gatecrasher left when the host asked to see his invitation.
entries.zh: 主人要求查看请柬时，那个不请自来的客人离开了。

entries.meaningZh: 做好准备；为行动作准备
entries.en: We need to gear up for a busy weekend at the bookshop.
entries.zh: 我们得为书店忙碌的周末做好准备。

entries.meaningZh: 哇；哎呀（表示惊讶，非正式）
entries.en: Gee whiz, I had no idea the attic was this big!
entries.zh: 哇，我完全没想到阁楼竟然这么大！

entries.meaningZh: 打破传统性别表现规范的人（非正式，常带冒犯性）
entries.en: The old review called the performer a gender-bender, a label she later rejected.
entries.zh: 那篇旧评论称这位表演者为打破性别规范者，她后来拒绝接受这一带有冒犯性的标签。

entries.meaningZh: 突破传统性别表现规范的做法或表现
entries.en: The exhibition explores gender-bending in stage costumes and performance.
entries.zh: 展览探讨了舞台服装和表演中突破传统性别表现规范的做法。

entries.meaningZh: 获得不利于某人的证据（常接 on，非正式）
entries.en: The investigator hoped to get the goods on the official before the hearing.
entries.zh: 调查员希望在听证会前取得对那名官员不利的证据。

entries.meaningZh: 给我；give me 的口语缩略形式
entries.en: Gimme a minute to find my shoes, and then we can go.
entries.zh: 给我一分钟找鞋，然后我们就能走了。

entries.meaningZh: 微光；隐约的光亮
entries.en: A faint glimmering beneath the door showed that someone was still awake.
entries.zh: 门下透出的隐约微光说明还有人没睡。

entries.meaningZh: 美其名的；被说得比实际更高级的（常用于贬低）
entries.en: The advertised study was little more than a glorified cupboard.
entries.zh: 广告里说的书房，其实不过是个被美化了的大壁橱。

entries.meaningZh: 用光面纸印刷的精美杂志（非正式，复数）
entries.en: The waiting room had a stack of glossies beside the old newspapers.
entries.zh: 候诊室里，旧报纸旁放着一摞精美的光面纸杂志。

entries.meaningZh: 对……进行口交（粗俗性俚语）
entries.en: The article explains why someone might decline to go down on a partner.
entries.zh: 文章解释了一个人为何可能拒绝为伴侣口交。

entries.meaningZh: 惊讶得瞪大眼睛的（非正式）
entries.en: The children stood goggle-eyed as the enormous puppet rose above the stage.
entries.zh: 巨大的木偶升到舞台上方时，孩子们惊讶得瞪大了眼睛。

entries.meaningZh: 入职奖金；为吸引人加入机构而支付的奖金（非正式）
entries.en: The company offered a golden hello to attract an experienced engineer.
entries.zh: 公司为吸引一位经验丰富的工程师，提出支付入职奖金。

entries.meaningZh: 谢天谢地，总算摆脱了！（表示庆幸某人或某物离开）
entries.en: Good riddance! That noisy old printer has caused nothing but trouble.
entries.zh: 总算摆脱了！那台吵闹的旧打印机除了添麻烦，什么也没干好。

entries.meaningZh: 八卦专栏；刊载名人私生活消息的栏目
entries.en: She skipped the gossip column and went straight to the book reviews.
entries.zh: 她跳过八卦专栏，直接看起了书评。

entries.meaningZh: 使长满草；在……上种草
entries.en: They plan to grass over the unused corner of the playground.
entries.zh: 他们计划在操场闲置的角落种上草。

entries.meaningZh: 园艺本领；种养植物的才能（英式）
entries.en: You must have green fingers to keep those orchids flowering so well.
entries.zh: 你能让那些兰花开得那么好，一定很有园艺本领。

entries.meaningZh: 盘问；严厉而持续的询问（非正式）
entries.en: The manager faced a grilling from customers about the missing orders.
entries.zh: 经理就订单失踪一事遭到了顾客的严厉盘问。

entries.meaningZh: 令人痛苦或难熬地（常修饰 hard、slow 等）
entries.en: Progress was grindingly slow while they searched the records by hand.
entries.zh: 他们手工查找记录时，进展慢得让人难熬。

entries.meaningZh: 有沟槽的；表面刻有槽纹的
entries.en: The grooved surface helped water run off the step.
entries.zh: 带沟槽的表面有助于排走台阶上的水。

entries.meaningZh: 基本规则；事先约定的办事原则
entries.en: Our first ground rule was that everyone would get a turn to speak.
entries.zh: 我们定下的第一条基本规则是每个人都有轮流发言的机会。

entries.meaningZh: 发牢骚的；抱怨不休的
entries.en: A grumbling passenger complained that the bus was too cold.
entries.zh: 一位发牢骚的乘客抱怨公交车里太冷。

entries.meaningZh: 热衷的；干劲过头的（非正式，常写 gung-ho）
entries.en: He was so gung ho about renovating the kitchen that he forgot we still needed somewhere to cook.
entries.zh: 他对翻修厨房热心得过了头，忘了我们还需要一个做饭的地方。

entries.meaningZh: 精心打扮；装饰（非正式）
entries.en: There is no need to gussy up for a picnic in our garden.
entries.zh: 来我们花园野餐不必精心打扮。

entries.meaningZh: 思维习惯；惯常的思考方式
entries.en: Questioning every assumption had become a habit of mind for her.
entries.zh: 质疑每一个假设已经成了她的思维习惯。

entries.meaningZh: 狗颈背部的毛（复数）
entries.en: The dog's hackles rose when the stranger reached over the gate.
entries.zh: 陌生人把手伸过大门时，狗颈背部的毛竖了起来。

entries.meaningZh: 硬路肩；高速公路边供紧急停车的铺装地带（英式）
entries.en: The broken-down van was standing on the hard shoulder.
entries.zh: 那辆抛锚的货车停在硬路肩上。

entries.meaningZh: 务实强硬的；不感情用事的
entries.en: The hard-nosed negotiator refused to accept a promise without written terms.
entries.zh: 那位务实强硬的谈判者拒绝接受没有书面条款的承诺。

entries.meaningZh: 通过固定线路连接的；硬接线的
entries.en: The alarm is hardwired into the building's electrical system.
entries.zh: 警报器通过固定线路接入了楼宇的电气系统。

entries.meaningZh: 小粒白芸豆（英式，常以干豆出售）
entries.en: She picked up a haricot bean to check whether it had softened enough.
entries.zh: 她拿起一粒白芸豆，检查它是否已经煮得够软。

entries.meaningZh: 心中考虑的是；打算要（宾语可置于 have 与 in mind 之间）
entries.en: I have in mind a small room with space for a desk and two chairs.
entries.zh: 我心中考虑的是一间能放下一张书桌和两把椅子的小房间。

entries.meaningZh: 领导；负责
entries.en: They asked her to head up the team restoring the old theatre.
entries.zh: 他们请她领导修复旧剧院的团队。

entries.meaningZh: 两人或两方的直接较量
entries.en: The final was a head-to-head between two sisters from the same club.
entries.zh: 决赛是来自同一家俱乐部的姐妹二人之间的直接较量。

entries.meaningZh: 高脂稀奶油（美式名称）
entries.en: He stirred a spoonful of heavy cream into the mushroom soup.
entries.zh: 他往蘑菇汤里搅入了一匙高脂稀奶油。

entries.meaningZh: 举行；hold 的过去式或过去分词
entries.en: The club held its first meeting in a borrowed classroom.
entries.zh: 俱乐部在借来的一间教室里举行了第一次会议。

entries.meaningZh: 受妻子严厉支配的（贬义、刻板的旧式说法）
entries.en: The comedy portrayed him as a hen-pecked husband who never dared disagree.
entries.zh: 那部喜剧把他塑造成一个惧内、从不敢表示异议的丈夫。

entries.meaningZh: 草本花境；种植草本观赏植物的带状花坛
entries.en: The herbaceous border was full of purple flowers in early summer.
entries.zh: 初夏时，那片草本花境开满了紫色花朵。

entries.meaningZh: 高地；地势较高的土地（分写表达，不是 highland 的规则复数）
entries.en: The high lands remained dry when the river flooded the lower fields.
entries.zh: 河水淹没低处田地时，那些高地仍然干燥。

entries.meaningZh: 大弥撒；有庄严仪式及圣乐的弥撒
entries.en: The choir rehearsed the music for high mass on Sunday.
entries.zh: 唱诗班为星期日的大弥撒排练圣乐。

entries.meaningZh: 较高的公众知名度；引人注目的公众形象
entries.en: The campaign gave the small charity a high profile in the local press.
entries.zh: 那场宣传活动使这家小慈善机构在当地报刊上受到广泛关注。

entries.meaningZh: 高清晰度的；高分辨率的
entries.en: A high-definition image revealed scratches that the smaller photograph had hidden.
entries.zh: 一张高清晰度图像显示出了小照片里看不见的划痕。

entries.meaningZh: 专横；盛气凌人、不顾他人意见的作风
entries.en: The volunteers objected to the chair's high-handedness in cancelling their event.
entries.zh: 志愿者们反对主席专横地取消他们的活动。

entries.meaningZh: 高冲击的；涉及脚步重重落地或跳跃的（锻炼）
entries.en: The timetable separates high-impact exercise classes from gentler stretching sessions.
entries.zh: 课程表把高冲击健身课与较温和的拉伸课分开列出。

entries.meaningZh: 浮夸的；装腔作势的（非正式）
entries.en: The highfalutin language made a simple invitation sound like a royal decree.
entries.zh: 那种浮夸的措辞把一封简单的邀请函写得像皇室诏令。

entries.meaningZh: 向上拉起；提起
entries.en: He had to hike up his trousers before stepping across the stream.
entries.zh: 他得先提起裤子，才能跨过小溪。

entries.meaningZh: 唉，真无聊；罢了（表示厌倦或轻微失望）
entries.en: Ho hum, another afternoon spent waiting for a delivery.
entries.zh: 唉，又是一个等送货的下午。

entries.meaningZh: 朝目标靠近；逐渐对准（常与 on 连用）
entries.en: The researchers began to home in on the source of the unusual signal.
entries.zh: 研究人员开始逐步锁定异常信号的来源。

entries.meaningZh: 受勋者名单；获国家荣誉者名册（英式）
entries.en: Her name appeared on the honours list after years of service to the community.
entries.zh: 为社区服务多年后，她的名字出现在了受勋者名单上。

entries.meaningZh: 逃学；擅自缺勤（常用于 play hooky，非正式）
entries.en: They decided to play hooky and spend the afternoon at the lake.
entries.zh: 他们决定逃课，去湖边度过那个下午。

entries.meaningZh: 可点击跳转的超链接（计算机用语）
entries.en: The hot link in the message opened a map of the meeting place.
entries.zh: 消息里的超链接打开了一张会面地点的地图。

entries.meaningZh: 出众的人或事物（非正式，常带赞赏或戏谑）
entries.en: She thought she was hot stuff after winning three games in a row.
entries.zh: 她连赢三局后，觉得自己可了不起了。

entries.meaningZh: ……怎么样？；用来提出建议的疑问表达
entries.en: How about a short walk before we sit down to dinner?
entries.zh: 我们坐下来吃晚饭前，先散一小会儿步怎么样？

entries.meaningZh: 全人类；人类整体
entries.en: The film imagines a future in which the human race lives on several planets.
entries.zh: 影片想象了一个人类生活在多个星球上的未来。

entries.meaningZh: 蹲伏躲避；安顿在安全处等候
entries.en: We decided to hunker down in the cabin until the storm had passed.
entries.zh: 我们决定躲在小屋里，等暴风雨过去。

entries.meaningZh: 浮冰；漂在水面上的大片平坦冰块
entries.en: A seal rested on an ice floe near the edge of the bay.
entries.zh: 一只海豹躺在海湾边缘附近的一块浮冰上。

entries.meaningZh: 有插图的（修正原名词标注）
entries.en: She chose an illustrated edition because the drawings clarified the machinery.
entries.zh: 她选了一本插图版，因为图画把机械结构解释得很清楚。

entries.meaningZh: 想象出来的事物；幻想（复数）
entries.en: His fearful imaginings kept him awake long after the house was quiet.
entries.zh: 屋里安静下来很久以后，他仍因那些可怕的幻想而无法入睡。

entries.meaningZh: 汽车防盗止动装置（本例不指牲畜击昏设备）
entries.en: A faulty immobilizer prevented the car from starting even with the correct key.
entries.zh: 防盗止动装置出了故障，即使用正确的钥匙，汽车也无法启动。

entries.meaningZh: 在缺席时；本人不在场地
entries.en: She received her degree in absentia while working overseas.
entries.zh: 她在海外工作期间，缺席获得了学位。

entries.meaningZh: 一般而言；总的来说
entries.en: In general, the smaller rooms warm up faster than the hall.
entries.zh: 一般而言，小房间比大厅暖和起来更快。

entries.meaningZh: 套着挽具；处于挽具牵系之中（本例为马的字面义）
entries.en: The horses waited in harness while the driver checked the wheels.
entries.zh: 车夫检查车轮时，马匹套着挽具等候着。

entries.meaningZh: 在进行中；已启动（常用于 set in train）
entries.en: The repairs were already in train when the new owner arrived.
entries.zh: 新主人到来时，修缮工作已经在进行了。

entries.meaningZh: 陷入困难或麻烦中
entries.en: The small bakery was in trouble after losing its largest customer.
entries.zh: 失去最大的客户后，那家小面包店陷入了困境。

entries.meaningZh: 店内的；在店铺内进行的（澳式常写 instore，亦写 in-store）
entries.en: The instore display showed how the folding table would look in a small kitchen.
entries.zh: 店内展示呈现了那张折叠桌放在小厨房里的样子。

entries.meaningZh: 除其他事项外；其中包括（正式）
entries.en: The letter requested, inter alia, a copy of the original invoice.
entries.zh: 信中除其他事项外，还要求提供原始发票的副本。

entries.meaningZh: 使人精神振奋的；令人恢复活力的
entries.en: The cold morning air felt invigorating after the stuffy train journey.
entries.zh: 坐过闷热的火车后，早晨清冷的空气让人精神一振。

entries.meaningZh: 由该事实本身；因此必然地（正式）
entries.en: A longer report is not ipso facto a better report.
entries.zh: 报告更长，并不因此就必然更好。

entries.meaningZh: 无可挽回地；不可救药地
entries.en: The rain left the paper decorations irredeemably soggy.
entries.zh: 雨把纸装饰淋得湿软不堪，再也无法挽救。

entries.meaningZh: 不论；不考虑
entries.en: The competition is open to residents irrespective of age.
entries.zh: 这项比赛对居民开放，不论年龄。

entries.meaningZh: 统筹协调的；各部分衔接配合的（英式）
entries.en: The two departments need a joined-up plan for repairing the bridge.
entries.zh: 两个部门需要一份协调配合的桥梁修缮计划。

entries.meaningZh: 杂耍抛接；把多个物体轮流抛起接住的活动
entries.en: Her juggling improved once she learned to keep her eyes on the highest ball.
entries.zh: 她学会把目光放在最高处的球上之后，抛接杂耍的水平提高了。

entries.meaningZh: 保存；keep 的过去式或过去分词
entries.en: He kept the ticket as a reminder of their first concert together.
entries.zh: 他保存着那张票，纪念他们第一次一起听音乐会。

entries.meaningZh: 驾车沿路边慢行以招揽性交易的行为（英式）
entries.en: Residents complained about kerb-crawling on the streets near the station.
entries.zh: 居民投诉车站附近街道上有人驾车慢行招揽性交易。

entries.meaningZh: 求胜狠劲；抓住机会击败对手的强烈意志（比喻）
entries.en: The coach said the team needed more killer instinct when it took the lead.
entries.zh: 教练说，球队取得领先时需要有更强的求胜狠劲。

entries.meaningZh: 针织的；用针线编织成的
entries.en: The knitted scarf caught on a nail beside the door.
entries.zh: 那条针织围巾挂在了门边的一颗钉子上。

entries.meaningZh: 编织针；织毛衣等所用的长针
entries.en: She used a knitting needle to count the stitches before starting the next row.
entries.zh: 开始织下一行前，她用一根编织针数了数针目。

entries.meaningZh: 很快做出；匆匆做成（英式，非正式）
entries.en: I can knock up a simple supper while you unpack.
entries.zh: 你收拾行李时，我可以很快做一顿简单的晚饭。

entries.meaningZh: 膝外翻的；站立时双膝靠拢而脚踝分开的
entries.en: The drawing shows a knock-kneed stance with a gap between the ankles.
entries.zh: 图画展示了一种膝外翻的站姿，两个脚踝之间留有空隙。

entries.meaningZh: 节省劳力的
entries.en: The labour-saving device made washing the floor much easier.
entries.zh: 那个节省劳力的装置让擦洗地板轻松多了。

entries.meaningZh: 具有吵闹、粗俗的年轻男性群体作风的（英式，常含贬义）
entries.en: The film relies on laddish jokes that several reviewers found tiresome.
entries.zh: 影片倚赖粗俗男孩式的笑话，几位评论者觉得很乏味。

entries.meaningZh: 行为被形容为像粗放男孩的年轻女子（英式非正式，常带贬义）
entries.en: The columnist called her a ladette, reducing her achievements to a tired stereotype.
entries.zh: 专栏作者称她为豪放女孩，用一个陈旧的刻板标签抹去了她的成就。

entries.meaningZh: 放置；lay 的过去式或过去分词
entries.en: She laid the wet gloves beside the stove to dry.
entries.zh: 她把湿手套放在炉边晾干。

entries.meaningZh: 膝上舞表演者；近身为坐着的顾客表演情色舞蹈的人
entries.en: The interview followed a former lap dancer who had opened her own café.
entries.zh: 访谈讲述了一位曾从事膝上舞表演、后来开了自己的咖啡馆的人的经历。

entries.meaningZh: 膝上舞；为坐着的顾客近身表演的情色舞蹈
entries.en: The council debated licensing conditions for venues offering lap dancing.
entries.zh: 地方议会讨论了提供膝上舞表演的场所应遵守的许可条件。

entries.meaningZh: 凤头麦鸡（Vanellus vanellus）
entries.en: A lapwing lifted from the field, its long crest visible against the sky.
entries.zh: 一只凤头麦鸡从田野飞起，长长的羽冠映衬在天空中。

entries.meaningZh: 令人失望的事；令人扫兴的结果（本例不是泌乳义）
entries.en: The ending was a let-down after such a promising opening chapter.
entries.zh: 开头一章那么吸引人，结局却令人失望。

entries.meaningZh: 生命支持设备；用于维持重要身体功能的机器
entries.en: The life-support machine continued running during the transfer to another ward.
entries.zh: 转往另一间病房时，生命支持设备持续运转着。

entries.meaningZh: 轻重量级选手（拳击等运动的级别名称）
entries.en: The light heavyweight faced an opponent with a much longer reach.
entries.zh: 那位轻重量级选手面对的是一名臂展长得多的对手。

entries.meaningZh: 酸橙绿色的；鲜亮的黄绿色的
entries.en: She painted the small cupboard lime green to brighten the kitchen.
entries.zh: 她把小橱柜漆成酸橙绿色，让厨房显得更明快。

entries.meaningZh: 唇彩；使嘴唇呈光泽的化妆品
entries.en: The lip gloss left a shiny mark on the rim of the cup.
entries.zh: 唇彩在杯口留下了一道亮亮的印迹。

entries.meaningZh: 生命；life 的复数
entries.en: The warning gave the families time to leave and saved many lives.
entries.zh: 预警让各家人有时间撤离，挽救了许多生命。

entries.meaningZh: 固有色；绘画中物体本身的颜色（不计光影变化）
entries.en: The tutor asked us to paint the apple's local colour before adding shadows.
entries.zh: 老师让我们先画出苹果的固有色，再添加阴影。

entries.meaningZh: 笨拙地蹦跳着走（非正式）
entries.en: We watched the young dog lollop across the uneven lawn.
entries.zh: 我们看着那只小狗笨拙地蹦跳着穿过凹凸不平的草坪。

entries.meaningZh: 懒散地消磨时间；闲待着
entries.en: We planned to lounge around until the hottest part of the day was over.
entries.zh: 我们打算闲待着，等一天中最热的时段过去。

entries.meaningZh: 磁石学校；以特色课程吸引跨学区学生的公立学校（美国）
entries.en: Her daughter applied to a magnet school with a strong performing arts programme.
entries.zh: 她女儿申请了一所表演艺术课程很强的磁石学校。

entries.meaningZh: 作出补偿；赔罪
entries.en: He offered to make amends by repairing the gate he had damaged.
entries.zh: 他提出修好自己弄坏的大门，以作补偿。

entries.meaningZh: 化妆品（本例不指捏造）
entries.en: She removed her make-up before washing the costume's collar.
entries.zh: 她先卸了妆，再清洗演出服的衣领。

entries.meaningZh: 男性朋友之间不带浪漫目的的聚会（非正式，不是 mandate）
entries.en: They jokingly called their evening at the cinema a man date.
entries.zh: 他们开玩笑地把一起去电影院的那个晚上称为男性朋友间的约会。

entries.meaningZh: 有大理石纹样的；呈斑驳纹理的
entries.en: The marbled paper made each notebook cover look slightly different.
entries.zh: 带大理石纹样的纸让每本笔记本的封面看起来都略有不同。

entries.meaningZh: 市场领先者；市场中销售或地位领先的企业或产品
entries.en: The small manufacturer hoped to challenge the market leader on price.
entries.zh: 那家小制造商希望在价格上挑战市场领先企业。

entries.meaningZh: 导师指导；由有经验者支持他人发展的活动
entries.en: The apprenticeship includes regular mentoring from an experienced craftsperson.
entries.zh: 学徒培训包括由经验丰富的手艺人定期提供的指导。

entries.meaningZh: 变性酒精；methylated spirits 的英式非正式简称
entries.en: The camping stove used meths rather than bottled gas.
entries.zh: 那个野营炉使用变性酒精，而不是瓶装燃气。

entries.meaningZh: 变性酒精；加入使其不宜饮用物质的工业酒精（英式）
entries.en: The bottle of methylated spirits was stored away from the food supplies.
entries.zh: 那瓶变性酒精与食品分开存放。

entries.meaningZh: 中档的；在价格或性能范围中居中的
entries.en: A mid-range camera was enough for the photographs she wanted to take.
entries.zh: 一台中档相机就足以拍摄她想拍的照片。

entries.meaningZh: 中景；视野中介于前景和远景之间的部分
entries.en: A red barn stood in the middle distance beyond the nearest trees.
entries.zh: 近处树木的后方，一座红色谷仓立在中景处。

entries.meaningZh: 温和中立的；不走极端的
entries.en: The party chose a middle-of-the-road candidate to appeal to undecided voters.
entries.zh: 该党选择了一位立场温和的候选人，以吸引尚未作出决定的选民。

entries.meaningZh: 送奶车；尤指短途送奶的电动车（英式）
entries.en: An electric milk float passed the house before the other traffic began.
entries.zh: 其他车辆还没开始通行，一辆电动送奶车就经过了房子。

entries.meaningZh: 甜馅饼；通常以香料干果馅制作的英式圣诞小馅饼
entries.en: She warmed a mince pie and served it with a spoonful of cream.
entries.zh: 她加热了一个干果甜馅饼，配上一匙奶油端了出来。

entries.meaningZh: 令人极其费解或惊异的（非正式）
entries.en: The puzzle ends with a mind-bending twist that changes the meaning of every clue.
entries.zh: 这道谜题以一个令人极其费解的转折结尾，改变了每条线索的含义。

entries.meaningZh: 被误解的
entries.en: The misunderstood instruction caused three groups to use the wrong entrance.
entries.zh: 那条被误解的指示让三个小组走错了入口。

entries.meaningZh: 当模特的工作；模特职业（英式拼写）
entries.en: She returned to modelling after taking a year off to study.
entries.zh: 休息一年去学习后，她重新从事模特工作。

entries.meaningZh: 将人撞倒；尤指车辆猛烈撞倒人
entries.en: The driver swerved to avoid the crowd rather than mow down the pedestrians.
entries.zh: 司机急忙转向避开人群，没有撞倒行人。

entries.meaningZh: 仔细考虑；反复琢磨
entries.en: I need a day to mull over the offer before I reply.
entries.zh: 回复之前，我需要一天时间仔细考虑这个提议。

entries.meaningZh: 多方面的；包含多个层面的
entries.en: The exhibition presents a multi-faceted portrait of life in the port.
entries.zh: 展览从多个方面呈现了港口的生活。

entries.meaningZh: 当保姆照顾儿童的工作
entries.en: She found that nannying suited her better than working in a crowded office.
entries.zh: 她发现，当保姆照顾孩子比在拥挤的办公室工作更适合自己。

entries.meaningZh: 民族国家；以共同民族认同作为国家基础的政治共同体
entries.en: The lecture traced the growth of the nation state alongside changes in citizenship.
entries.zh: 讲座结合公民身份的变化，追溯了民族国家的发展。

entries.meaningZh: 民族国家；以共同民族认同作为国家基础的政治共同体
entries.en: The course examines how the modern nation-state developed in Europe.
entries.zh: 这门课程研究现代民族国家如何在欧洲形成。

entries.meaningZh: 天体主义；在合适场所集体裸体活动的生活方式
entries.en: The campsite has a separate area for visitors who practise naturism.
entries.zh: 营地为过天体生活的游客设有独立区域。

entries.meaningZh: 轮胎火刑；以燃烧轮胎杀人的暴力行径
entries.en: The commission documented cases of necklacing during the unrest.
entries.zh: 委员会记录了动乱期间发生的轮胎火刑案件。

entries.meaningZh: 新型男性；愿意平等分担家务并重视女性平等的男性（旧式社会标签）
entries.en: The interview praised him as a new man for sharing childcare with his partner.
entries.zh: 访谈称赞他与伴侣分担育儿责任，是一位新型男性。

entries.meaningZh: 去夜总会消遣；逛夜店
entries.en: They had little energy left for nightclubbing after a day of sightseeing.
entries.zh: 观光一整天后，他们已经没多少精力再去逛夜店了。

entries.meaningZh: 没什么了不起；不太出色（非正式）
entries.en: My singing is no great shakes, but I enjoy joining in.
entries.zh: 我唱歌不怎么样，但我喜欢跟着一起唱。

entries.meaningZh: 无论；不管（后接疑问词）
entries.en: No matter how carefully I fold the map, it never fits back into its cover.
entries.zh: 无论我多么仔细地折地图，它都再也装不回封套里。

entries.meaningZh: 没有人
entries.en: No one noticed the missing button until the photograph was printed.
entries.zh: 直到照片印出来，才有人注意到少了一颗纽扣。

entries.meaningZh: 绝不；没门儿（非正式拒绝）
entries.en: No way! I am not carrying that sofa up three flights of stairs.
entries.zh: 没门儿！我可不把那张沙发搬上三段楼梯。

entries.meaningZh: 令人失望、没产生预期效果的事件（非正式）
entries.en: With the main speaker absent, the much-advertised debate became a non-event.
entries.zh: 主要演讲者缺席，使那场大肆宣传的辩论变得乏善可陈。

entries.meaningZh: 非工会的；未加入工会的
entries.en: The report compared pay for union and non-union workers.
entries.zh: 报告比较了工会会员与非工会工人的工资。

entries.meaningZh: 远远没有；远不及
entries.en: The cupboard is nowhere near big enough for all these plates.
entries.zh: 这个橱柜远远不够大，放不下所有这些盘子。

entries.meaningZh: 惹人注目而令人不快地；碍眼地
entries.en: The new antenna projected obtrusively above the old roofline.
entries.zh: 新天线突出于旧屋顶的轮廓之上，显得很碍眼。

entries.meaningZh: 在所有……之中（后接名词等）
entries.en: Of all the rooms in the house, this one gets the best morning light.
entries.zh: 在房子所有的房间中，这间早晨的采光最好。

entries.meaningZh: 偏偏是……；竟然是……（表示出乎意料）
entries.en: He collects, of all things, old bus tickets.
entries.zh: 他收藏的竟然是旧公交车票。

entries.meaningZh: 偏离路线或航向地
entries.en: The strong current carried the boat off course.
entries.zh: 强劲的水流使小船偏离了航向。

entries.meaningZh: 现成可用的；从现货中购买而无需定制的
entries.en: We bought the software off the shelf and adjusted our workflow to suit it.
entries.zh: 我们购买了现成软件，并调整工作流程来适应它。

entries.meaningZh: 出售供带走饮用酒类的商店（英式）
entries.en: The off-licence next to the station had already closed for the evening.
entries.zh: 车站旁那家外卖酒类商店当晚已经关门了。

entries.meaningZh: 越野车；可在不平路面行驶的机动车
entries.en: Their off-roader was too tall for the entrance to the underground car park.
entries.zh: 他们的越野车太高，进不了地下停车场的入口。

entries.meaningZh: 惹祸的；造成问题的
entries.en: She removed the offending file, and the printer began working again.
entries.zh: 她移除了造成问题的文件，打印机便又开始工作了。

entries.meaningZh: 老处女纸牌游戏；配对后避免剩下单张牌的游戏名称
entries.en: We played old maid at the kitchen table until the rain stopped.
entries.zh: 我们在厨房桌边玩老处女纸牌游戏，一直玩到雨停。

entries.meaningZh: 年老的女性；老妇人（字面义）
entries.en: An old woman was tending the roses beside the gate.
entries.zh: 一位老妇人正在大门旁照料玫瑰。

entries.meaningZh: 刻意仿旧的；营造古雅风格的（英式，常含戏谑）
entries.en: The café's olde worlde décor included fake beams and copper pots.
entries.zh: 那家咖啡馆刻意仿旧的装饰包括仿制横梁和铜锅。

entries.meaningZh: 接连成功；势头正旺（非正式）
entries.en: The team is on a roll after winning its last four matches.
entries.zh: 球队赢下了最近四场比赛，正势头强劲。

entries.meaningZh: 用极少的资金；预算拮据地
entries.en: They put on the entire festival on a shoestring.
entries.zh: 他们用极少的资金办成了整个节庆活动。

entries.meaningZh: 朝着预定目标；按计划前进
entries.en: The repairs are on course to finish before the winter rains.
entries.zh: 修缮正按计划进行，有望在冬雨来临前完成。

entries.meaningZh: 一见就；一看见便
entries.en: The caretaker recognised the missing dog on sight.
entries.zh: 看守人一眼就认出了那只走失的狗。

entries.meaningZh: 一边进行一边；临时即兴地
entries.en: We had to change the route on the fly when the footbridge was closed.
entries.zh: 人行桥关闭后，我们不得不在途中临时改变路线。

entries.meaningZh: 在旅途中；四处旅行着
entries.en: After three weeks on the road, they were glad to sleep in their own beds.
entries.zh: 在外旅行三周后，他们很高兴终于能睡在自己的床上。

entries.meaningZh: 被男性同伴视为自己人的人（非正式）
entries.en: He tried too hard to be one of the boys and laughed at jokes he disliked.
entries.zh: 他过于努力地想成为男伙伴眼中的自己人，连不喜欢的笑话也跟着笑。

entries.meaningZh: 没有越位的（体育）
entries.en: The replay showed that the striker had been onside when the ball was passed.
entries.zh: 回放显示，传球时前锋并没有越位。

entries.meaningZh: 因花钱或损失而少了钱的；有未获补偿支出的
entries.en: The cancelled booking left us out of pocket by fifty pounds.
entries.zh: 预订被取消，使我们损失了五十英镑。

entries.meaningZh: 销量超过；outsell 的过去式或过去分词
entries.en: The cheaper model outsold the premium version throughout the summer.
entries.zh: 整个夏天，便宜款的销量都超过了高档款。

entries.meaningZh: 克服；overcome 的过去式
entries.en: She overcame her fear of deep water during the lessons.
entries.zh: 她在学习过程中克服了对深水的恐惧。

entries.meaningZh: 煮得过头的；烹调过久的
entries.en: The overdone carrots fell apart when he tried to lift them from the pan.
entries.zh: 他想把胡萝卜从锅里夹出来时，煮过头的胡萝卜碎开了。

entries.meaningZh: 透支银行账户；overdraw 的过去分词
entries.en: She had overdrawn the account before the delayed payment arrived.
entries.zh: 那笔延迟的款项到账之前，她已经透支了账户。

entries.meaningZh: 吃得过多的人
entries.en: The diary helped the overeater notice that boredom often triggered his extra meals.
entries.zh: 日记帮助这位进食过量者意识到，无聊常常会让他额外吃东西。

entries.meaningZh: 支付过多；overpay 的过去式或过去分词
entries.en: I overpaid the invoice because I counted the delivery charge twice.
entries.zh: 我把运费算了两次，所以多付了发票上的款项。

entries.meaningZh: 超过；赶超；overtake 的过去式
entries.en: A cyclist overtook us as we struggled up the hill.
entries.zh: 我们费力上坡时，一名骑车人超过了我们。

entries.meaningZh: 踱步；pace 的过去式或过去分词（本例选动词）
entries.en: He paced the corridor until the interview room door opened.
entries.zh: 他在走廊里来回踱步，直到面试室的门打开。

entries.meaningZh: 驮畜；用于驮运货物的动物
entries.en: Each pack animal carried two balanced loads up the mountain path.
entries.zh: 每头驮畜都驮着左右平衡的两份货物，沿山路向上走。

entries.meaningZh: 疼痛关口；剧烈运动中须忍受的疼痛阶段
entries.en: The memoir describes the runner's struggle to push through the pain barrier.
entries.zh: 回忆录描述了那位跑者努力突破疼痛关口的过程。

entries.meaningZh: 南美潘帕斯草原（常用 the pampas）
entries.en: Cattle grazed on the pampas beyond the last line of trees.
entries.zh: 最后一排树的那一边，牛群在潘帕斯草原上吃草。

entries.meaningZh: 送报路线及沿线的送报工作（美式）
entries.en: Her paper route took her past the bakery before it opened.
entries.zh: 她的送报路线经过那家面包店时，店还没有开门。

entries.meaningZh: 长尾小鹦鹉；parakeet 的另一拼写
entries.en: The parrakeet climbed along the branch to reach a piece of apple.
entries.zh: 那只长尾小鹦鹉沿着树枝爬过去，够一块苹果。

entries.meaningZh: 随用随付的；按实际使用量预付或付费的
entries.en: She bought a pay-as-you-go phone for the short trip.
entries.zh: 她为短途旅行买了一部随用随付的手机。

entries.meaningZh: 行为艺术；以艺术家现场行动作为媒介的艺术形式
entries.en: The gallery hosted performance art alongside its painting exhibition.
entries.zh: 画廊在举办绘画展览的同时，还呈现了行为艺术。

entries.meaningZh: 假战；二战初期西线相对平静的时期（1939—1940年）
entries.en: His diary from the Phoney War records long waits interrupted by drills.
entries.zh: 他在假战时期的日记记录了漫长的等待，以及其间穿插的操练。

entries.meaningZh: 一件家具
entries.en: The cabinet was the only piece of furniture that survived the flood.
entries.zh: 那个柜子是洪水过后唯一完好保留下来的一件家具。

entries.meaningZh: 拉皮条；从他人的卖淫活动中牟利的行为（本例非旧形容词义）
entries.en: The investigation uncovered allegations of pimping as well as financial fraud.
entries.zh: 调查发现了涉嫌拉皮条以及财务欺诈的问题。

entries.meaningZh: 供张贴欣赏的明星或模特照片（非正式）
entries.en: A faded pin-up of a film star was still taped inside the wardrobe door.
entries.zh: 衣柜门内侧仍贴着一张褪色的影星照片。

entries.meaningZh: 供张贴欣赏的明星或模特照片（亦写 pin-up）
entries.en: She found a pinup from an old magazine among her mother's letters.
entries.zh: 她在母亲的信件中发现了一张从旧杂志上取下的明星照片。

entries.meaningZh: 比特斗牛梗；pit bull 类型的犬
entries.en: The pit bull terrier waited beside its owner while she fastened the lead.
entries.zh: 主人系好牵绳时，那只比特斗牛梗在她身旁等着。

entries.meaningZh: 塑性炸药；可塑形成形的炸药材料
entries.en: The laboratory report identified traces of plastic explosive on the damaged casing.
entries.zh: 实验室报告在受损外壳上检出了塑性炸药的痕迹。

entries.meaningZh: 合作；愿意配合（非正式）
entries.en: The supplier would not play ball unless we paid the overdue bill.
entries.zh: 除非我们支付逾期账单，否则供应商就不肯配合。

entries.meaningZh: 英国人（澳大利亚、新西兰俚语，可能带贬义）
entries.en: He disliked being called a pommy simply because of his accent.
entries.zh: 他不喜欢别人仅仅因为他的口音，就用 pommy 这种称呼叫他英国佬。

entries.meaningZh: 绒球；装饰用的毛线球（亦写 pom-pom，本例非火炮义）
entries.en: The red pompom on her hat bounced as she ran for the bus.
entries.zh: 她跑去赶公交车时，帽子上的红色绒球一颠一颠地跳动。

entries.meaningZh: 有人居住的；人口聚居的
entries.en: The populated valley was much noisier than the empty hills above it.
entries.zh: 有人居住的山谷比上方空旷的山丘嘈杂得多。

entries.meaningZh: 积极差别待遇；为改善弱势群体地位而给予优先待遇的做法
entries.en: The panel debated whether positive discrimination was the best way to widen access.
entries.zh: 小组讨论了积极差别待遇是否是扩大参与机会的最佳办法。

entries.meaningZh: 研究生；postgraduate 的非正式简称
entries.en: A postgrad from the chemistry department showed us around the laboratory.
entries.zh: 一位化学系的研究生带我们参观了实验室。

entries.meaningZh: 大肚子的；腹部圆鼓的
entries.en: A pot-bellied pig rooted through the straw beside the shed.
entries.zh: 一头大肚猪在棚屋旁的稻草里拱来拱去。

entries.meaningZh: 炸薯片；薄而脆的油炸土豆片（英式）
entries.en: A potato crisp snapped under the lid when he closed the lunchbox.
entries.zh: 他盖上饭盒时，一片炸薯片被盒盖压断了。

entries.meaningZh: 尤为突出地；首屈一指地
entries.en: The town is pre-eminently a fishing port, although tourism is growing.
entries.zh: 尽管旅游业正在增长，这座镇最突出的身份仍是渔港。

entries.meaningZh: 先前已存在的
entries.en: The survey recorded preexisting cracks before construction began next door.
entries.zh: 隔壁施工开始前，勘验记录了先前已存在的裂缝。

entries.meaningZh: 在前面加上（prefix 的过去式或过去分词）
entries.en: The clerk prefixed each file number with a letter indicating the year.
entries.zh: 办事员在每个档案编号前加了一个表示年份的字母。

entries.meaningZh: 继续前进；坚持做下去
entries.en: We decided to press on while there was still enough daylight.
entries.zh: 趁着天还够亮，我们决定继续前进。

entries.meaningZh: 初步看来成立的；表面上有根据的（正式）
entries.en: The review found a prima facie case for examining the disputed invoices.
entries.zh: 审查发现，初步已有理由进一步核查那些有争议的发票。

entries.meaningZh: 经验证的；已证实有效的
entries.en: They chose a proven design rather than risk an untested mechanism.
entries.zh: 他们选择了经过验证的设计，没有冒险使用未经测试的机构。

entries.meaningZh: 膨化的；膨起变松的
entries.en: The puffed rice lost its crispness after the packet was left open.
entries.zh: 包装袋敞开放着后，膨化米失去了酥脆口感。

entries.meaningZh: 推；push 的现在分词（本例选动词）
entries.en: She was pushing the trolley with one hand and holding the door with the other.
entries.zh: 她一只手推着手推车，另一只手扶着门。

entries.meaningZh: 进入四分之一决赛的选手；八强选手
entries.en: The quarter-finalist withdrew after injuring her ankle during practice.
entries.zh: 那位八强选手在训练中伤了脚踝，随后退出了比赛。

entries.meaningZh: 累计获得（分数、成就、费用等，非正式）
entries.en: The team hopes to rack up enough points before the final round.
entries.zh: 球队希望在最后一轮之前积累足够的分数。

entries.meaningZh: 货架；成组架设的储物架
entries.en: The warehouse installed taller racking to make better use of the space.
entries.zh: 仓库安装了更高的货架，以便更充分地利用空间。

entries.meaningZh: 驾车撞入店面抢劫的人（英式）
entries.en: The ram-raider abandoned the stolen car a few streets from the shop.
entries.zh: 那名驾车撞店抢劫的人把偷来的汽车丢在离商店几条街的地方。

entries.meaningZh: 漫无边际的话或文字（复数，常含贬义）
entries.en: Her ramblings filled three pages before she reached the point of the letter.
entries.zh: 她漫无边际地写了三页，才说到这封信的重点。

entries.meaningZh: 响；ring 的过去式
entries.en: The telephone rang just as I stepped into the shower.
entries.zh: 我刚走进淋浴间，电话就响了。

entries.meaningZh: 讨厌的家伙；混蛋（英式、澳式非正式，侮辱语）
entries.en: She called the driver a ratbag after he deliberately splashed the waiting passengers.
entries.zh: 司机故意把水溅到等车的乘客身上后，她骂他是个混蛋。

entries.meaningZh: 快速而不费力地说出或背出
entries.en: He can rattle off the names of every station on the line.
entries.zh: 他能不假思索地快速说出这条线上的每一个车站名。

entries.meaningZh: 热闹花哨的宣传或表演（非正式）
entries.en: The little book launch had none of the razzamatazz of a celebrity event.
entries.zh: 那场小型新书发布会没有名人活动那种花哨热闹的场面。

entries.meaningZh: 炫目的花招；令人眼花缭乱的展示（非正式）
entries.en: Beneath the razzle-dazzle, the show had very little story.
entries.zh: 抛开那些令人眼花缭乱的花招，演出几乎没有什么故事。

entries.meaningZh: 再次当选；连任
entries.en: Her re-election gave the committee another year of stable leadership.
entries.zh: 她的再次当选让委员会又有了一年稳定的领导。

entries.meaningZh: 感到放心的；疑虑已得到消除的
entries.en: The parents sounded reassured after speaking to the trip organiser.
entries.zh: 家长们与旅行组织者谈过后，听起来放心了。

entries.meaningZh: 反射疗法从业者；通过按压手足特定部位提供服务的人
