entries.en: The reflexologist explained what the session would involve before it began.
entries.zh: 那位反射疗法从业者在开始前解释了这次服务包含哪些内容。

entries.meaningZh: 改过自新的；已改掉某种坏习惯的
entries.en: The reformed troublemaker now helped younger pupils settle their disputes.
entries.zh: 那个改过自新的捣蛋学生如今会帮助低年级学生解决争执。

entries.meaningZh: 偿还；repay 的过去式或过去分词
entries.en: She repaid the loan in small monthly amounts.
entries.zh: 她每月偿还一小笔钱，逐步还清了贷款。

entries.meaningZh: 令人厌恶地；使人反感地
entries.en: The dumped food smelled repulsively sweet in the afternoon heat.
entries.zh: 午后的炎热中，丢弃的食物散发出一种令人恶心的甜腻气味。

entries.meaningZh: 获得资源配置的；配有经费或人员等的
entries.en: The project was adequately resourced, but its timetable was unrealistic.
entries.zh: 这个项目的资源配置足够，但时间表不切实际。

entries.meaningZh: 公路休息区；供行车者停车休息的区域
entries.en: We stopped at a rest area to stretch our legs and refill the water bottles.
entries.zh: 我们在一个公路休息区停车，活动了一下腿脚，又灌满了水瓶。

entries.meaningZh: 即将退休的；即将离职的
entries.en: The retiring headteacher planted a tree in the school garden.
entries.zh: 即将退休的校长在学校花园里种了一棵树。

entries.meaningZh: 胸廓；由肋骨等构成的胸部骨性支架
entries.en: The diagram showed the heart's position within the rib cage.
entries.zh: 示意图显示了心脏在胸廓内的位置。

entries.meaningZh: 步枪射击场；练习步枪射击的场地
entries.en: The rifle range closed while its safety barriers were repaired.
entries.zh: 步枪射击场在维修安全隔挡期间关闭了。

entries.meaningZh: 持正当看法的；有正确道德判断的（常为说话人的评价）
entries.en: The speaker claimed that every right-thinking person would support the proposal.
entries.zh: 演讲者声称，每一个明辨是非的人都会支持这项提议。

entries.meaningZh: 以鸣钟迎接；用钟声宣告到来
entries.en: The church plans to ring in the new year with all six bells.
entries.zh: 教堂计划用全部六口钟的钟声迎接新年。

entries.meaningZh: 道路施工；道路修缮工程（英式，复数）
entries.en: The roadworks added twenty minutes to our morning journey.
entries.zh: 道路施工让我们早晨的行程多花了二十分钟。

entries.meaningZh: 火箭科学家；研究火箭技术的科学工作者（字面义）
entries.en: The rocket scientist used a small model to explain the launch sequence.
entries.zh: 火箭科学家用一个小模型解释了发射顺序。

entries.meaningZh: 骑；ride 的过去式
entries.en: He rode his bicycle along the canal to avoid the traffic.
entries.zh: 他沿运河骑自行车，以避开交通拥堵。

entries.meaningZh: 翻高领的；领子高起并向外翻卷的（服装）
entries.en: A roll-neck sweater kept her warm without a scarf.
entries.zh: 一件翻高领毛衣让她不用围巾也能保持暖和。

entries.meaningZh: 手卷香烟（英式，非正式；不是雪茄）
entries.en: He put out his roll-up before entering the workshop.
entries.zh: 他进作坊前熄灭了手卷香烟。

entries.meaningZh: 玫瑰水；用玫瑰制成的芳香水（本例选名词）
entries.en: A little rosewater gave the rice pudding a delicate floral scent.
entries.zh: 少许玫瑰水给米布丁添上了淡淡的花香。

entries.meaningZh: 将……列入考虑；认定……仍有可能
entries.en: The new evidence allowed the team to rule in a second possible explanation.
entries.zh: 新证据使团队能够把第二种可能的解释也列入考虑。

entries.meaningZh: 四处跑动；到处忙碌
entries.en: The children could run around safely in the fenced garden.
entries.zh: 孩子们可以在有围栏的花园里安全地四处跑动。

entries.meaningZh: 把……告诉某人以征求意见（宾语常插入 run 与 by 之间）
entries.en: Can I run the revised schedule by you before I send it out?
entries.zh: 我把修改后的日程发出去之前，可以先征求一下你的意见吗？

entries.meaningZh: 不容批评的人、观念或制度（比喻）
entries.en: The report challenged the sacred cow that every department needed its own office.
entries.zh: 报告质疑了那个不容批评的观念：每个部门都需要自己的办公室。

entries.meaningZh: 使悲伤（sadden 的现在分词，本例非金属加工义）
entries.en: The closure of the old theatre is saddening many local residents.
entries.zh: 老剧院关闭一事让许多当地居民感到悲伤。

entries.meaningZh: 施虐受虐倾向或行为；将施虐与受虐结合的性倾向或行为
entries.en: The textbook distinguishes sadomasochism from masochism alone.
entries.zh: 教材区分了施虐受虐倾向与单纯的受虐倾向。

entries.meaningZh: 轻松通过；毫不费力地完成
entries.en: She expected to sail through the audition but found the rhythm exercise difficult.
entries.zh: 她原以为能轻松通过试演，却发现节奏练习很难。

entries.meaningZh: 淫秽性；露骨渲染性内容的特征
entries.en: The reviewer criticised the film's salaciousness rather than its technical quality.
entries.zh: 评论者批评的是影片露骨的性内容，而不是它的技术质量。

entries.meaningZh: 鲑鱼粉；带橙色调的粉红色
entries.en: She chose salmon pink for the invitation cards and cream for the envelopes.
entries.zh: 她选了鲑鱼粉色的请柬和奶油色的信封。

entries.meaningZh: 储存起来以备将来使用；积攒（非正式）
entries.en: They managed to salt away a little money every month.
entries.zh: 他们设法每个月存下一点钱。

entries.meaningZh: 唱；sing 的过去式（本例非植物名词）
entries.en: The children sang quietly while the youngest one fell asleep.
entries.zh: 最小的孩子渐渐睡着时，其他孩子轻声唱着歌。

entries.meaningZh: 下沉；sink 的过去式
entries.en: The stone sank before we could see where it landed.
entries.zh: 还没看清石头落在水里的位置，它就沉下去了。

entries.meaningZh: 香肠肉酥卷；用酥皮包香肠肉烤成的点心
entries.en: He bought a warm sausage roll from the bakery for lunch.
entries.zh: 他从面包店买了一个热香肠肉酥卷当午饭。

entries.meaningZh: 锯开；saw 的过去分词
entries.en: The carpenter had sawn the plank into three equal pieces.
entries.zh: 木匠已经把那块木板锯成了三等份。

entries.meaningZh: 危言耸听；散布令人恐慌的信息（贬义）
entries.en: The editor rejected the headline as scaremongering unsupported by the report.
entries.zh: 编辑认为标题是在危言耸听，缺乏报告依据，因此没有采用。

entries.meaningZh: 科技园；集中科技研发及相关企业的园区
entries.en: The company moved into a science park near the university.
entries.zh: 公司搬进了大学附近的一座科技园。

entries.meaningZh: 烧焦的；烤焦的
entries.en: The scorched tablecloth smelled of smoke even after washing.
entries.zh: 那块烧焦的桌布即使洗过，仍有烟味。

entries.meaningZh: 炒散的；搅拌后炒熟的（本例指鸡蛋）
entries.en: She served scrambled eggs on toast before the early train.
entries.zh: 赶早班火车前，她端上了配吐司的炒鸡蛋。

entries.meaningZh: 老水手；经验丰富的海员（非正式）
entries.en: The old sea dog knew the harbour by the shape of its cliffs.
entries.zh: 那位老水手凭峭壁的形状就认出了港口。

entries.meaningZh: 第二童年；把老年认知衰退比作回到童年的旧式说法（可冒犯）
entries.en: The memoir uses second childhood to describe the grandfather's decline, a phrase the editor questions.
entries.zh: 回忆录用第二童年来描述祖父的衰退，编辑对这一说法提出了质疑。

entries.meaningZh: 再从堂表亲；双方父母互为堂表兄弟姐妹的同辈亲属
entries.en: My second cousin brought a photograph of our great-grandparents to the reunion.
entries.zh: 我的再从表亲把一张我们共同的曾祖父母辈祖先的照片带到了家庭聚会。

entries.meaningZh: 明白道理；接受合理意见
entries.en: We hoped he would see reason before signing such an unfair agreement.
entries.zh: 我们希望他在签署那份如此不公平的协议前能够明白道理。

entries.meaningZh: 留作播种的谷粒或玉米；种粮（字面义）
entries.en: The farmer kept the seed corn separate from the grain intended for sale.
entries.zh: 农民把种粮与准备出售的粮食分开存放。

entries.meaningZh: 看见；see 的过去分词
entries.en: I had never seen the square so empty on a market day.
entries.zh: 我从未见过广场在集市日这么空。

entries.meaningZh: 卡住；停止正常运转（机器）
entries.en: The old pump may seize up if it is left unused all winter.
entries.zh: 如果整个冬天都闲置不用，旧水泵可能会卡住。

entries.meaningZh: 自我宣传；推销自己的才能或成就
entries.en: He was good at the work but uncomfortable with self-promotion.
entries.zh: 他很擅长那项工作，却不习惯自我宣传。

entries.meaningZh: 自发面粉；预先加入化学膨松剂的面粉（英式，不是加酵母）
entries.en: The recipe calls for self-raising flour, so she checked the bag before measuring it.
entries.zh: 配方要求用自发面粉，所以她量取前先检查了包装袋。

entries.meaningZh: 自立的；依靠自己的能力的
entries.en: Living alone made him more self-reliant about cooking and household repairs.
entries.zh: 独居使他在做饭和家居维修方面更加自立。

entries.meaningZh: 自发面粉；预先加入膨松剂的面粉（美式，不是加酵母）
entries.en: The baker used self-rising flour for the biscuits instead of adding baking powder separately.
entries.zh: 面包师用自发面粉做小松饼，没有另外添加泡打粉。

entries.meaningZh: 转卖；买入后再卖给别人（本例非说服义）
entries.en: They hoped to repair the damaged bicycles and sell on the ones they did not need.
entries.zh: 他们希望修好那些损坏的自行车，再把不需要的转卖出去。

entries.meaningZh: 半圆形的
entries.en: The semi-circular bench followed the curve of the flowerbed.
entries.zh: 那张半圆形长凳沿着花坛的弧线摆放。

entries.meaningZh: 寄出；send 的过去式或过去分词
entries.en: She sent the parcel on Monday and kept the receipt.
entries.zh: 她星期一寄出了包裹，并保存了收据。

entries.meaningZh: 精心安排的独立段落或场景（戏剧、电影等）
entries.en: The chase was the film's best set piece, with every movement carefully timed.
entries.zh: 追逐戏是影片最出色的精心设计的场面，每个动作的时机都经过仔细安排。

entries.meaningZh: 缝；sew 的过去分词
entries.en: He had sewn a strip of bright fabric onto the backpack.
entries.zh: 他已经在背包上缝了一条鲜艳的布。

entries.meaningZh: 性对象；被仅仅视为满足性欲工具的人
entries.en: The actor objected to being treated as a sex object rather than a skilled performer.
entries.zh: 那位演员反对被仅仅当作性对象，而不是一名有技艺的表演者。

entries.meaningZh: 受到惊吓或震动的；心绪不安的
entries.en: She was shaken by the near collision and stopped to catch her breath.
entries.zh: 那次险些发生的碰撞把她吓得不轻，她停下来缓了缓。

entries.meaningZh: 穿着鞋的（常与 in 连用，文学用语）
entries.en: His feet were shod in boots too large for him.
entries.zh: 他脚上穿着一双对他来说太大的靴子。

entries.meaningZh: 发光；照耀；shine 的过去式或过去分词
entries.en: The moon shone through a gap in the curtains.
entries.zh: 月光从窗帘的缝隙中照进来。

entries.meaningZh: 摇动；shake 的过去式（本例选动词）
entries.en: He shook the empty box to check whether anything was still inside.
entries.zh: 他摇了摇空盒子，检查里面是否还剩着东西。

entries.meaningZh: 已剪去毛的；剃短的
entries.en: The newly shorn sheep looked much smaller without their thick wool.
entries.zh: 刚剪过毛的羊少了厚厚的羊毛，看起来小了许多。

entries.meaningZh: 短波的；属于短波频段的
entries.en: The short-wave broadcast faded as the storm drew closer.
entries.zh: 暴风雨逼近时，短波广播的声音渐渐变弱。

entries.meaningZh: 垫肩；衣服中垫在肩部的衬垫
entries.en: A shoulder pad had slipped out of place inside the jacket lining.
entries.zh: 夹克衬里的一块垫肩移了位。

entries.meaningZh: 带领参观；领着某人四处看（宾语可插在 show 与 around 之间）
entries.en: Would you show our new colleague around after lunch?
entries.zh: 午饭后，你能带新同事四处参观一下吗？

entries.meaningZh: 展示；show 的过去分词
entries.en: The guide had shown us the courtyard before taking us into the hall.
entries.zh: 导游带我们进入大厅之前，已经领我们看过了庭院。

entries.meaningZh: 缩水；缩小；shrink 的过去式
entries.en: The woollen hat shrank when I washed it in hot water.
entries.zh: 我用热水洗那顶羊毛帽时，它缩水了。

entries.meaningZh: 缩小；shrink 的过去分词
entries.en: The pile of unanswered letters has shrunk to just two envelopes.
entries.zh: 那堆尚未回复的信已经减少到只剩两个信封。

entries.meaningZh: 视奏；不经事先练习，照着初见的乐谱演奏
entries.en: She can sight-read a simple piano piece without stopping.
entries.zh: 她能不间断地视奏一首简单的钢琴曲。

entries.meaningZh: 标志曲；与某节目或表演者固定联系的主题音乐
entries.en: The programme's signature tune was recognisable from its first three notes.
entries.zh: 那个节目的标志曲只响起前三个音符就能被认出来。

entries.meaningZh: 设置路标指示（signpost 的过去式或过去分词）
entries.en: The organisers signposted the route from the station to the fairground.
entries.zh: 组织者设置了路标，指示从车站到集市场地的路线。

entries.meaningZh: 用丝网印刷（修正原名词标注）
entries.en: They silk-screen the design onto cotton bags in a small workshop.
entries.zh: 他们在一间小作坊里把图案丝网印到棉布袋上。

entries.meaningZh: 垂枝桦（Betula pendula）
entries.en: The silver birch outside the window shed yellow leaves onto the path.
entries.zh: 窗外的垂枝桦把黄色落叶撒在了小径上。

entries.meaningZh: 跟着唱；伴随他人或录音一起唱（开放式动词拼写）
entries.en: The chorus is easy enough for everyone to sing along.
entries.zh: 副歌很简单，足以让每个人都跟着唱。

entries.meaningZh: 跳台滑雪的跳台；滑雪者起跳的平台或斜坡
entries.en: Snow piled up beneath the ski jump after the overnight storm.
entries.zh: 夜间暴风雪过后，跳台滑雪的跳台下积起了雪。

entries.meaningZh: 矿渣堆；冶炼或采矿废渣堆成的土丘
entries.en: We could see the slag heap beyond the disused railway line.
entries.zh: 我们能看见废弃铁路线另一侧的矿渣堆。

entries.meaningZh: 被杀害的（文学或新闻用语）
entries.en: The memorial bears the names of the slain villagers.
entries.zh: 纪念碑上刻着遇害村民的名字。

entries.meaningZh: 睡；sleep 的过去式或过去分词
entries.en: We slept through the storm and found the fallen branches in the morning.
entries.zh: 暴风雨期间我们一直睡着，早晨才发现掉落的树枝。

entries.meaningZh: 匝道；连接主路与进出口的短路段（英式）
entries.en: The slip road was closed, so we stayed on the motorway until the next exit.
entries.zh: 匝道关闭了，所以我们沿高速公路一直开到下一个出口。

entries.meaningZh: 滑坡式恶化的危险过程；一步引向更坏后果的局面（比喻）
entries.en: The committee feared that ignoring one safety complaint would put it on a slippery slope.
entries.zh: 委员会担心，忽视一项安全投诉会使自己走上逐步恶化的危险道路。

entries.meaningZh: 随手挂起或甩到某处（sling 的过去式或过去分词）
entries.en: He slung his bag over one shoulder and hurried towards the platform.
entries.zh: 他把包甩到一侧肩上，匆匆走向站台。

entries.meaningZh: 迷恋的；深深着迷的
entries.en: She was smitten with the little seaside town from her first visit.
entries.zh: 她第一次到访，就深深喜欢上了那座海滨小镇。

entries.meaningZh: 重击；smite 的过去式（文学用语）
entries.en: The knight smote the wooden shield with his sword.
entries.zh: 骑士用剑重击了木盾。

entries.meaningZh: 令人警醒的；使人严肃起来的
entries.en: The empty shelves were a sobering reminder of how much stock the flood had destroyed.
entries.zh: 空荡荡的货架令人警醒，提醒人们洪水毁掉了多少库存。

entries.meaningZh: 该死的；讨厌的（英式粗俗语，用于表示恼怒）
entries.en: The sodding lock has jammed again, and my keys are inside.
entries.zh: 这该死的锁又卡住了，我的钥匙还在里面。

entries.meaningZh: 卖出；sell 的过去式或过去分词
entries.en: They sold the spare desk to a neighbour who was setting up an office.
entries.zh: 他们把闲置的书桌卖给了一位正在布置办公室的邻居。

entries.meaningZh: 溶剂滥用；为获得精神作用而故意吸入挥发性溶剂的行为
entries.en: The youth centre organised a discussion about the risks of solvent abuse.
entries.zh: 青年中心组织了一场关于溶剂滥用风险的讨论。

entries.meaningZh: 混蛋；狗娘养的（粗俗侮辱语）
entries.en: He called the dishonest dealer a son of a bitch after discovering the forged receipt.
entries.zh: 发现收据是伪造的后，他骂那个不诚实的商人为混蛋。

entries.meaningZh: 寻求；seek 的过去式或过去分词
entries.en: The villagers sought help from the neighbouring town after the bridge collapsed.
entries.zh: 桥梁坍塌后，村民们向邻镇寻求帮助。

entries.meaningZh: 播种；sow 的过去分词
entries.en: The beans had been sown in straight rows along the fence.
entries.zh: 豆子已经沿着篱笆一排排整齐地播种好了。

entries.meaningZh: 恍惚的；注意力不集中的（非正式，亦写 spacey）
entries.en: After the overnight journey, I felt too spacy to follow the conversation.
entries.zh: 连夜赶路后，我感到恍恍惚惚，跟不上谈话。

entries.meaningZh: 快速行进；speed 的过去式或过去分词
entries.en: The train sped through the small station without stopping.
entries.zh: 火车飞快地驶过小站，没有停下。

entries.meaningZh: 迷人的；令人入迷的（本例选形容词）
entries.en: The storyteller gave a spellbinding account of the voyage.
entries.zh: 讲故事的人对那次航行作了令人入迷的描述。

entries.meaningZh: 装有尖钉的；带尖刺的
entries.en: The spiked fence made the abandoned yard difficult to enter.
entries.zh: 带尖刺的围栏使人很难进入那个废弃院子。

entries.meaningZh: 洒出；spill 的过去式或过去分词（英式常见）
entries.en: I spilt the tea while reaching for the sugar bowl.
entries.zh: 我伸手拿糖罐时把茶洒了。

entries.meaningZh: 被宠坏的；娇纵的（英式拼写）
entries.en: The spoilt child demanded a new toy before agreeing to leave the shop.
entries.zh: 那个被宠坏的孩子非要一个新玩具，才肯离开商店。

entries.meaningZh: 突然跳起；spring 的过去式
entries.en: The cat sprang onto the wall when the gate slammed shut.
entries.zh: 大门砰地关上时，猫一下跳到了墙上。

entries.meaningZh: 大潮；日月引潮作用相合时潮差较大的潮汐（不是春季潮）
entries.en: The spring tide exposed a wide stretch of sand at low water.
entries.zh: 大潮在低潮时露出了一大片沙地。

entries.meaningZh: 突然出现或萌生；spring 的过去分词
entries.en: New shoots have sprung from the base of the damaged tree.
entries.zh: 受损树木的基部长出了新芽。

entries.meaningZh: 舞台提示；剧本中关于动作、布景等的说明
entries.en: A stage direction tells the actor to pause before opening the letter.
entries.zh: 一条舞台提示要求演员在打开信件前停顿一下。

entries.meaningZh: 利益相关者养老金；符合特定标准的英国个人养老金类别
entries.en: She filed the letter about her stakeholder pension with her annual statements.
entries.zh: 她把关于自己利益相关者养老金的信件与年度对账单归档在一起。

entries.meaningZh: 独立运行的；无需其他设备或系统支持的
entries.en: The sensor works as a stand-alone unit without a connection to the main computer.
entries.zh: 这个传感器作为独立装置运行，无需连接主计算机。

entries.meaningZh: 代表；表示（stand for 的第三人称单数）
entries.en: The letter R stands for return on this ticket.
entries.zh: 这张票上的字母 R 表示往返。

entries.meaningZh: 单口喜剧；由一人面向观众讲述笑话的表演
entries.en: She tried standup at a small club before writing comedy for radio.
entries.zh: 她为电台创作喜剧之前，曾在一家小俱乐部尝试单口喜剧表演。

entries.meaningZh: 观星；观看夜空中的星体
entries.en: Clouds spoiled our plans for stargazing after dinner.
entries.zh: 云层打乱了我们晚饭后观星的计划。

entries.meaningZh: 转向柱；连接方向盘与转向机构的柱状部件
entries.en: The mechanic removed the cover from the steering column to inspect the wiring.
entries.zh: 机械师取下转向柱的外罩，检查里面的线路。

entries.meaningZh: 继兄弟；父母一方再婚配偶的儿子（无共同的亲生父母）
entries.en: My step-brother moved in after my father married his mother.
entries.zh: 我父亲与他母亲结婚后，我的继兄弟搬来和我们同住。

entries.meaningZh: 继姐妹；父母一方再婚配偶的女儿（不是同父或同母姐妹）
entries.en: Her step-sister joined the family when her mother remarried.
entries.zh: 她母亲再婚时，她的继姐妹加入了这个家庭。

entries.meaningZh: 陷害；故意安排使人受骗或受责的圈套（英式非正式）
entries.en: He claimed that the disciplinary hearing was a stitch-up arranged by his rival.
entries.zh: 他声称，那场纪律听证会是对手安排的一场陷害。

entries.meaningZh: 已去核的（水果，英式）
entries.en: She folded stoned cherries into the cake mixture.
entries.zh: 她把去核的樱桃轻轻拌入蛋糕糊。

entries.meaningZh: 石磨磨制的
entries.en: The loaf was made with stoneground flour from a local mill.
entries.zh: 那条面包是用当地磨坊的石磨面粉制作的。

entries.meaningZh: 站立；stand 的过去式或过去分词
entries.en: We stood under the porch until the rain eased.
entries.zh: 我们站在门廊下，等雨势减弱。

entries.meaningZh: 震荡磨合期；团队发展中成员意见冲突的阶段
entries.en: During storming, the team argued about roles before agreeing on a way to work together.
entries.zh: 在震荡磨合期，团队先就角色分工发生争论，之后才商定合作方式。

entries.meaningZh: 正直而循规蹈矩的人（美式非正式）
entries.en: Her brother was a straight arrow who always returned anything he borrowed.
entries.zh: 她哥哥为人正直规矩，借了什么都会归还。

entries.meaningZh: 撒满；散布；strew 的过去分词
entries.en: Broken branches were strewn across the path after the gale.
entries.zh: 大风过后，断枝撒满了小路。

entries.meaningZh: 把……穿起或挂起（本例非使紧张义）
entries.en: We can string up the lanterns between those two trees.
entries.zh: 我们可以把灯笼挂在那两棵树之间。

entries.meaningZh: 大步走；stride 的过去式
entries.en: She strode across the hall to retrieve the forgotten folder.
entries.zh: 她大步穿过大厅，去拿遗忘的文件夹。

entries.meaningZh: 努力；strive 的过去式
entries.en: They strove to finish the roof before the forecast rain arrived.
entries.zh: 他们努力赶在预报的降雨到来前修完屋顶。

entries.meaningZh: 击打；撞击；strike 的过去式或过去分词
entries.en: The falling branch struck the empty wheelbarrow.
entries.zh: 掉落的树枝砸中了空手推车。

entries.meaningZh: 串起；string 的过去式或过去分词
entries.en: The children strung coloured beads onto a length of cotton.
entries.zh: 孩子们把彩色珠子串到一段棉线上。

entries.meaningZh: 卡住的；无法移动的
entries.en: The drawer was stuck, so I emptied the cabinet before trying again.
entries.zh: 抽屉卡住了，所以我先清空柜子，再试了一次。

entries.meaningZh: 蜇；刺伤；sting 的过去式或过去分词
entries.en: A wasp stung him while he was picking up the fallen pears.
entries.zh: 他捡掉落的梨时，被一只黄蜂蜇了。

entries.meaningZh: 某某的；某一个未明确指名的（常用 such and such a）
entries.en: He kept saying that such and such a friend could solve the problem, but he never gave a name.
entries.zh: 他不停地说某某朋友能解决问题，却始终不说名字。

entries.meaningZh: 唱；sing 的过去分词
entries.en: That song has been sung at every family gathering I can remember.
entries.zh: 在我记得的每次家庭聚会上，都有人唱过那首歌。

entries.meaningZh: 沉没；sink 的过去分词
entries.en: The little boat had sunk before the rescue crew reached it.
entries.zh: 救援人员赶到之前，那艘小船已经沉没了。

entries.meaningZh: 游泳；swim 的过去式
entries.en: They swam across the narrow inlet before breakfast.
entries.zh: 他们早饭前游过了狭窄的海湾水道。

entries.meaningZh: 酸甜味的（常用于菜肴）
entries.en: The sauce tasted sweet and sour, with a hint of fresh ginger.
entries.zh: 酱汁尝起来酸酸甜甜的，带着一丝鲜姜味。

entries.meaningZh: 打扫；sweep 的过去式或过去分词
entries.en: He swept the porch before putting the chairs outside.
entries.zh: 他先扫干净门廊，再把椅子搬到外面。

entries.meaningZh: 经宣誓的；在誓言约束下作出的
entries.en: The inquiry collected sworn statements from the witnesses.
entries.zh: 调查收集了证人们经宣誓作出的陈述。

entries.meaningZh: 游泳；swim 的过去分词
entries.en: She had swum farther than she intended before noticing the time.
entries.zh: 她看时间时才发现，自己已经游得比原计划更远了。

entries.meaningZh: 摆动；swing 的过去式或过去分词
entries.en: The loose gate swung back and struck the wall.
entries.zh: 松动的大门向后摆去，撞在墙上。

entries.meaningZh: 行驶记录仪；记录车辆速度、行驶时间等的装置
entries.en: The mechanic checked the tachograph before returning the lorry to its driver.
entries.zh: 机械师检查了行驶记录仪，才把货车交还给司机。

entries.meaningZh: 跟车过近；紧贴前车行驶的行为
entries.en: The instructor warned that tailgating leaves little time to react.
entries.zh: 教练提醒，跟车过近会让反应时间所剩无几。

entries.meaningZh: 已被占用的；已有人的（座位等）
entries.en: That seat is taken, but the one by the window is free.
entries.zh: 那个座位已经有人了，不过窗边那个还空着。

entries.meaningZh: 花哨地装饰或打扮（英式非正式，常含贬义）
entries.en: They tried to tart up the shabby lobby with gold paint and plastic flowers.
entries.zh: 他们想用金色涂料和塑料花把破旧的大堂装饰得花哨一些。

entries.meaningZh: 教；teach 的过去式或过去分词
entries.en: My grandfather taught me to mend a bicycle puncture.
entries.zh: 祖父教会了我修补自行车漏气的轮胎。

entries.meaningZh: 出租车候客站；出租车等候乘客的指定地点
entries.en: A porter directed us to the taxi stand outside the arrivals hall.
entries.zh: 一位行李员指引我们去到达大厅外的出租车候客站。

entries.meaningZh: 茶桌布；喝茶时铺在小桌上的桌布（英式）
entries.en: She spread a clean tea cloth over the little table by the window.
entries.zh: 她在窗边的小桌上铺了一块干净的茶桌布。

entries.meaningZh: 茶室；供应茶和小点心的营业场所
entries.en: The tea room served warm scones until late afternoon.
entries.zh: 那家茶室一直供应热司康饼到傍晚前。

entries.meaningZh: 勉强使自己离开；忍痛抽身（常用 tear oneself away）
entries.en: I had to tear myself away from the book to answer the door.
entries.zh: 我不得不依依不舍地放下书，去开门。

entries.meaningZh: 替马西泮；一种苯二氮䓬类药物（仅作名称示例）
entries.en: The pharmacist checked the label on the temazepam package.
entries.zh: 药剂师检查了替马西泮包装上的标签。

entries.meaningZh: 乐曲速度；tempo 的复数
entries.en: The conductor tried two different tempi before choosing the slower one.
entries.zh: 指挥试了两种不同的乐曲速度，最后选择了较慢的那个。

entries.meaningZh: 线路终点；terminus 的复数
entries.en: Both termini of the tram line have shelters and ticket machines.
entries.zh: 这条有轨电车线路的两个终点都设有候车棚和售票机。

entries.meaningZh: 短信；通过手机等发送的简短文字消息
entries.en: A text message from the driver confirmed the new pickup time.
entries.zh: 司机发来一条短信，确认了新的接人时间。

entries.meaningZh: 使用热能的；与热有关的（作名词前定语）
entries.en: Engineers inspected the cooling system at the thermo power station.
entries.zh: 工程师们检查了那座火力发电站的冷却系统。

entries.meaningZh: 严厉盘问；反复逼问（非正式，及物）
entries.en: Her relatives tried to third-degree her about the unexpected journey.
entries.zh: 她的亲戚们试图就那次出人意料的旅行对她反复逼问。

entries.meaningZh: 投掷；throw 的过去式
entries.en: He threw the rope across the stream on his second attempt.
entries.zh: 他第二次尝试时把绳子扔过了小溪。

entries.meaningZh: 扔；throw 的过去分词
entries.en: Someone had thrown an old blanket over the broken chair.
entries.zh: 有人把一条旧毯子扔在了坏椅子上。

entries.meaningZh: 一分一秒地过去（时间）
entries.en: The final minutes seemed to tick away faster than she could write.
entries.zh: 最后几分钟仿佛流逝得比她写字还快。

entries.meaningZh: 怠速运转（发动机，英式）
entries.en: The engine continued to tick over while the driver checked the map.
entries.zh: 司机查看地图时，发动机继续怠速运转着。

entries.meaningZh: 弹片游戏中的小圆片；用较大片弹起的小筹片
entries.en: The blue tiddlywink landed just short of the cup.
entries.zh: 那枚蓝色的小弹片落在杯前，差一点就进去了。

entries.meaningZh: 给小费的行为或习惯（本例非倾卸设备义）
entries.en: The guide explained local tipping customs to the visitors.
entries.zh: 导游向游客解释了当地给小费的习惯。

entries.meaningZh: 以牙还牙的；针锋相对报复的
entries.en: The two clubs exchanged tit-for-tat complaints about each other's supporters.
entries.zh: 两家俱乐部以牙还牙，互相投诉对方的支持者。

entries.meaningZh: 按订制要求；根据顾客要求制作地
entries.en: The carpenter makes these cabinets to order rather than keeping finished ones in stock.
entries.zh: 木匠按顾客要求订制这些柜子，不储存做好的成品。

entries.meaningZh: 至少可以说；往轻里说（用于含蓄地加强语气）
entries.en: The missing roof was inconvenient, to say the least.
entries.zh: 屋顶没了，往轻里说也相当不方便。

entries.meaningZh: 告诉；tell 的过去式或过去分词
entries.en: She told us which path would avoid the flooded field.
entries.zh: 她告诉我们走哪条小路可以避开被淹的田地。

entries.meaningZh: 好得令人难以置信；好得让人怀疑是否真实
entries.en: The offer of a free holiday sounded too good to be true.
entries.zh: 免费度假的提议听起来好得让人怀疑是否真实。

entries.meaningZh: 拿；take 的过去式
entries.en: He took the smaller suitcase because it would fit under the seat.
entries.zh: 他拿了较小的行李箱，因为它能放进座位下面。

entries.meaningZh: 成套工具；用于某类工作的工具组合
entries.en: The tool kit contained a hammer, two screwdrivers and a small spanner.
entries.zh: 那套工具包括一把锤子、两把螺丝刀和一把小扳手。

entries.meaningZh: 高端的；同类产品中价格或品质较高的
entries.en: The shop displayed its top-end bicycles in the front window.
entries.zh: 商店把高端自行车陈列在前面的橱窗里。

entries.meaningZh: 撕破；tear 的过去式
entries.en: She tore the envelope while trying to remove the sticky label.
entries.zh: 她想撕下黏住的标签时，把信封撕破了。

entries.meaningZh: 撕破的；破裂的
entries.en: A torn pocket let the coins fall into the coat lining.
entries.zh: 一个破口袋让硬币掉进了外套衬里。

entries.meaningZh: 结果未定而有危险的；成败难料的
entries.en: It was touch and go whether the repairs would finish before the hall reopened.
entries.zh: 修缮能否在大厅重新开放前完成，当时还很难说。

entries.meaningZh: 过分强调感情表达和亲密接触的（非正式，常含贬义）
entries.en: He disliked the workshop's touchy-feely exercises and preferred a practical discussion.
entries.zh: 他不喜欢研讨会里那些过分强调感情交流的练习，更愿意作实际的讨论。

entries.meaningZh: 难对付的强硬人物（非正式）
entries.en: The negotiator had a reputation as a tough nut who rarely accepted the first offer.
entries.zh: 那位谈判者以强硬难对付著称，很少接受第一次报价。

entries.meaningZh: 工会会员；参与工会活动的人
entries.en: The trade unionist helped colleagues prepare questions about the proposed shifts.
entries.zh: 那位工会成员帮助同事准备有关拟议轮班安排的问题。

entries.meaningZh: 牵引挂车式货车；由牵引车和挂车组成的车辆
entries.en: The trailer truck needed extra room to turn into the narrow yard.
entries.zh: 那辆牵引挂车式货车需要额外的空间才能转进狭窄的院子。

entries.meaningZh: 超觉静坐；一种特定的冥想方法名称
entries.en: The community centre listed an introductory talk on transcendental meditation.
entries.zh: 社区中心列出了一场介绍超觉静坐的讲座。

entries.meaningZh: 跨性别的；性别认同与出生时指定性别不同的
entries.en: The transgender actor spoke about finding roles beyond the usual stereotypes.
entries.zh: 那位跨性别演员谈到了如何找到超越常见刻板形象的角色。

entries.meaningZh: 踩踏；tread 的过去式
entries.en: He trod on a loose floorboard, and it creaked beneath him.
entries.zh: 他踩到一块松动的地板，脚下随即吱呀一响。

entries.meaningZh: 踩踏；tread 的过去分词
entries.en: Someone had trodden mud across the freshly cleaned floor.
entries.zh: 有人踩着泥走过了刚打扫干净的地板。

entries.meaningZh: 令人担忧的；令人不安的
entries.en: The missing pages raised troubling questions about the accuracy of the report.
entries.zh: 丢失的页面引出了令人担忧的问题，使人怀疑报告是否准确。

entries.meaningZh: 变音符号；置于字母上方的两点符号（如 ä）
entries.en: She added the umlaut above the letter a before saving the German name.
entries.zh: 保存那个德语名字前，她在字母 a 上方加上了两点变音符号。

entries.meaningZh: 保密的；尚未公开的
entries.en: The new design remained under wraps until the exhibition opened.
entries.zh: 新设计在展览开幕前一直保密。

entries.meaningZh: 未煮熟的；烹调不足的
entries.en: The potatoes were underdone, so he returned the dish to the oven.
entries.zh: 土豆还没熟透，所以他把那盘菜重新放回了烤箱。

entries.meaningZh: 理解；understand 的过去式或过去分词
entries.en: She understood the instructions once the guide demonstrated the first step.
entries.zh: 向导演示了第一步后，她便理解了说明。

entries.meaningZh: 承担；undertake 的过去式
entries.en: The local group undertook the restoration of the neglected fountain.
entries.zh: 当地团体承担了那座失修喷泉的修复工作。

entries.meaningZh: 经历；undergo 的过去式
entries.en: The old station underwent major repairs before reopening.
entries.zh: 旧车站经过大规模修缮后重新开放。

entries.meaningZh: 解开；undo 的过去式
entries.en: She undid the knot before trying to pull the rope free.
entries.zh: 她先解开绳结，再试着把绳子抽出来。

entries.meaningZh: 穿制服的
entries.en: A uniformed attendant checked tickets at the entrance.
entries.zh: 一位穿制服的工作人员在入口检查门票。

entries.meaningZh: 卸载；移除已安装的软件
entries.en: I need to uninstall the old program before installing its replacement.
entries.zh: 安装替代软件之前，我需要先卸载旧程序。

entries.meaningZh: 未说出口的；未明言的
entries.en: Too many important things remained unsaid when the meeting ended.
entries.zh: 会议结束时，仍有太多重要的事情没有说出口。

entries.meaningZh: 过去经常；过去曾经（后接动词原形）
entries.en: We used to buy vegetables from the farmer at the end of the lane.
entries.zh: 我们过去常向巷子尽头的农民买蔬菜。

entries.meaningZh: 曲张静脉；发生异常扩张、弯曲的静脉血管
entries.en: The diagram marks a varicose vein close to the surface of the leg.
entries.zh: 示意图标出了一条靠近腿部表面的曲张静脉。

entries.meaningZh: 非常离奇的；极不寻常的（非正式）
entries.en: The exhibition included some way-out designs for houses shaped like trees.
entries.zh: 展览里有一些极其离奇的设计，把房子设计成树的形状。

entries.meaningZh: 被重物压着的；负重累累的
entries.en: The walkers were weighed down with equipment they hardly used.
entries.zh: 步行者们被几乎用不着的装备压得负重累累。

entries.meaningZh: 润滑充分的；上足油的（本例为机械字面义）
entries.en: The well-oiled hinge moved silently even in the cold.
entries.zh: 即使天气寒冷，上足油的铰链转动时也没有声音。

entries.meaningZh: 去；go 的过去式
entries.en: We went to the smaller market after finding the main square closed.
entries.zh: 发现主广场关闭后，我们去了较小的集市。

entries.meaningZh: 哭泣；weep 的过去式或过去分词
entries.en: She wept with relief when the missing dog came home.
entries.zh: 走失的狗回家时，她如释重负地哭了。

entries.meaningZh: ……怎么样？；用来提出建议或询问某事的表达
entries.en: What about meeting at the library instead of the noisy café?
entries.zh: 改在图书馆见面，不去那家吵闹的咖啡馆，怎么样？

entries.meaningZh: 如果……会怎样？；假如……怎么办？
entries.en: What if the last train leaves before the concert ends?
entries.zh: 如果音乐会还没结束，末班火车就开走了，怎么办？

entries.meaningZh: 那么……呢？；……的情况又怎样？
entries.en: The builders can start tomorrow, but what of the missing materials?
entries.zh: 施工人员明天就能开工，可缺少的材料怎么办呢？

entries.meaningZh: 讨价还价并钻营交易（非正式，常含贬义）
entries.en: He liked to wheel and deal at auctions, but he often bought more than he could sell.
entries.zh: 他喜欢在拍卖会上讨价还价、四处钻营，却常常买得比卖得多。

entries.meaningZh: 锁车轮；用车轮锁使车辆无法移动的行为
entries.en: The notice warned drivers about wheel-clamping in the private car park.
entries.zh: 告示提醒司机，私人停车场内可能会锁住违规车辆的车轮。

entries.meaningZh: 精于交易或钻营的人（非正式，常含贬义）
entries.en: The wheeler-dealer offered to buy the whole collection before anyone else could make a bid.
entries.zh: 那个精于钻营的人提出买下整批藏品，抢在其他人出价之前。

entries.meaningZh: 爱发牢骚的人（英式非正式，贬义；本例非旧式刀名）
entries.en: He dismissed every customer who complained as a whinger.
entries.zh: 他把每一个投诉的顾客都贬称为爱发牢骚的家伙。

entries.meaningZh: 维也纳香肠；法兰克福香肠（美式非正式）
entries.en: He put a wienie in each roll before passing the plates around.
entries.zh: 他在每个面包卷里放了一根维也纳香肠，然后把盘子分给大家。

entries.meaningZh: 沉默寡言而不愿交往的；内向退缩的
entries.en: He seemed withdrawn at first but joined the conversation over dinner.
entries.zh: 他起初显得沉默寡言，但吃晚饭时加入了谈话。

entries.meaningZh: 撤回；withdraw 的过去式
entries.en: The club withdrew its complaint after receiving a written apology.
entries.zh: 收到书面道歉后，俱乐部撤回了投诉。

entries.meaningZh: 醒来；wake 的过去式
entries.en: I woke before dawn and heard rain tapping on the roof.
entries.zh: 我天亮前醒来，听见雨滴敲打屋顶。

entries.meaningZh: 叫醒；wake 的过去分词
entries.en: The thunder had woken the children, who were now sitting on the stairs.
entries.zh: 雷声吵醒了孩子们，他们这会儿正坐在楼梯上。

entries.meaningZh: 潮虫；鼠妇类陆生等足甲壳动物（不是土鳖昆虫）
entries.en: A woodlouse crawled out from beneath the damp flowerpot.
entries.zh: 一只潮虫从潮湿的花盆下面爬了出来。

entries.meaningZh: 穿戴；wear 的过去式
entries.en: She wore thick gloves to carry the rough timber.
entries.zh: 她戴着厚手套搬运粗糙的木料。

entries.meaningZh: 编织；weave 的过去式（本例不选纸张形容词）
entries.en: He wove narrow strips of willow into a shallow basket.
entries.zh: 他用细柳条编成了一只浅篮子。

entries.meaningZh: 编织成的；机织的
entries.en: The woven basket was strong enough to hold all the apples.
entries.zh: 那只编织篮子很结实，足以装下所有苹果。

entries.meaningZh: 写；write 的过去式
entries.en: She wrote the address twice because the first copy was hard to read.
entries.zh: 她把地址写了两遍，因为第一遍写得不易辨认。

entries.meaningZh: 拧干；wring 的过去式或过去分词
entries.en: He wrung the wet cloth over the bucket before wiping the floor.
entries.zh: 他在桶上方拧干湿布，再擦地板。

entries.meaningZh: 谨上；写给不知姓名收信人的正式信件结尾（英式）
entries.en: Dear Sir or Madam, please send me the current course brochure. Yours faithfully, Alex Green.
entries.zh: 尊敬的先生或女士：请寄给我现行课程手册。谨上，亚历克斯·格林。

entries.meaningZh: 谨启；写给已知姓名收信人的正式信件结尾（英式）
entries.en: Dear Ms Cole, thank you for arranging the visit. Yours sincerely, Alex Green.
entries.zh: 科尔女士：感谢您安排这次参观。谨启，亚历克斯·格林。

entries.meaningZh: 嚎叫；发出拖长而凄厉的叫声（yowl 的现在分词）
entries.en: A cat was yowling outside the closed kitchen door.
entries.zh: 一只猫在关着的厨房门外凄厉地嚎叫。

entries.meaningZh: 拉上拉链
entries.en: Please zip up the bag so the papers do not fall out.
entries.zh: 请把包的拉链拉上，免得文件掉出来。
